recent_facts.fact: The Dodgers won 100 games and are the two-time defending champions. As a division winner they got a first-round bye and are still alive. They face the Braves in the NLDS, after Atlanta beat Philadelphia 2-1 in the Wild Card Series.

NL bracket: No. 1 Brewers (103 wins) vs. No. 4 Padres, and No. 2 Dodgers vs. No. 3 Braves. AL bracket: No. 1 Rays vs. Yankees, and No. 2 Guardians vs. White Sox. The Padres, Yankees and White Sox all swept their Wild Card Series.

The best-of-five NLDS starts Saturday, Oct. 3, with the Dodgers hosting the Braves at 4 p.m. ET on Fox/FS1, and can run through about Oct. 9–10. The World Series starts Friday, Oct. 23, and would end by Oct. 31 if it goes seven games. To win, the Dodgers must take the NLDS (best of 5), the NLCS (best of 7) and the World Series (best of 7).
Dodgers NLDS rotation: Yoshinobu Yamamoto in Game 1, Blake Snell in Game 2, and Tarik Skubal in Game 3 at Atlanta.

Shohei Ohtani came off the 15-day IL for the final homestand and said he would 'most likely' not pitch again this season. He hit 5-for-21 with 8 strikeouts in his last five games, and he missed Thursday's team workout and simulated game.

Ohtani hit .275 with an .889 OPS and 30 HR in the regular season. GM Brandon Gomes said everything 'is feeling great physically,' and manager Dave Roberts called Ohtani 'as healthy as he's been in quite some time.'

Injuries have thinned Atlanta's rotation. Its Game 1 starter is TBD, Chris Sale can't pitch before Game 2, and Tyler Mahle and Martín Pérez can't pitch before Game 3. Bryce Elder (knee surgery) is out for the series. The Dodgers expect Ohtani and Freddie Freeman to be healthier after the five-day layoff, and RHP Edgardo Henriquez is set to return from a back injury.

Bye teams in the Division Series under the current format (2022–2025): 2 of 4 won in 2022, 1 of 4 in 2023, 3 of 4 in 2024, and reportedly 3 of 4 in 2025, for about 9 of 16 overall. That is only 16 series, and the 2025 count comes from search summaries, so treat it as unverified. The 2022 Dodgers, a bye team, lost in the NLDS.
In the Wild Card era, the team with the best regular-season record won the World Series 7 times in 29 seasons (24.1%). The 2026 Dodgers (100 wins) did not have MLB's best record; the Brewers won 103.

The Dodgers are trying to win a third straight title. From memory, and unverified: the last MLB team to win three in a row was the 1998–2000 Yankees, and no team has won three straight in the 12-team playoff format that began in 2022.

recent_facts.fact: O Povo's weighted average of polls as of Sept 28 put Ciro Gomes (PSDB) at 44.57% and Governor Elmano de Freitas (PT) at 43.83% for the first round. All other candidates combined polled about 2%.

Datafolha (1,204 voters, Sept 22–24, ±3 pts) had Ciro at 44% and Elmano at 43% in total votes, or 49% to 48% in valid votes. That leaves neither above the 50% needed to win in the first round. In a runoff, Ciro had 48% and Elmano 46%, down from an 8-point Ciro lead in the previous Datafolha poll.

Paraná Pesquisas (1,352 voters in 59 municipalities, Sept 23–25, ±2.7 pts) had Ciro at 46.0% and Elmano at 42.2%. In valid votes that is Ciro 50.8% and Elmano 46.5%. The same poll found 57.7% approval of Elmano's government.
AtlasIntel (1,800 voters, ±2 pts, released Sept 21) had Elmano at 48.5% and Ciro at 48%, with others at 1.5% and undecided or blank at 1.8%.
In Quaest's earlier poll (Aug 31–Sept 3), Ciro led Elmano 49% to 36% in a runoff. Ciro's lead shrank from 13 points to 3 points by Quaest's Sept 23 poll.

Ipsos-Ipec (800 voters, Aug 14–17) had Ciro at 43% and Elmano at 35% in the first round, with Ciro at 50% in a runoff. Elmano's rejection rate was 25% and Ciro's 20%, and Elmano's government had 57% approval.

The first round is on Oct 4, 2026. If no candidate gets more than 50% of valid votes, a runoff is held on Oct 25, 2026. The question closes Oct 5 at 03:59 UTC, but it resolves on whoever wins the election, including a runoff.

If the game is canceled outright with no make-up game, the draw question resolves Yes and the Argentina-win question resolves No. If it is postponed, both questions stay open until the game is played. A draw resolves the Argentina-win question No.

The friendly is set for Saturday, October 3, 2026, at 21:00 Argentina time (00:00 UTC on October 4) at the Estadio Monumental in Buenos Aires. FotMob lists 20:00 UTC, so sources disagree on the kickoff time. It is Argentina's second of three home friendlies in this window: Bolivia, Burkina Faso, then Benin on October 6.
Argentina's last match before this one was a 4-0 friendly win over Bolivia at the Estadio Mario Alberto Kempes in Córdoba.

Argentina's probable lineup: E. Martínez; Giay, Romero, Lisandro Martínez, and Vega or Medina; Paz and Exequiel Palacios in midfield; Julián Álvarez and Lautaro Martínez up front. Tagliafico has a minor problem but could still play. Enzo Fernández may return after serving a suspension.
Messi will not play against Burkina Faso, as he also did not play against Bolivia. He is being saved for the Benin match on October 6, which the article frames as his farewell.

Players listed as unavailable for Argentina through injury: Lo Celso, Foyth, Almada and Tagliafico. Burkina Faso is without Ismahila Ouédraogo through injury. Another preview (Khel Now) says both squads are fully available, so sources disagree.

This is the first senior meeting between the two countries, so there is no head-to-head record. Recent form: Argentina W-W-W-L-W; Burkina Faso W-L-D-D-W, most recently a 1-0 win over the Central African Republic in 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifying.
Burkina Faso is coached by Amir Abdou. Its squad includes Edmond Tapsoba, Issa Kaboré, Dango Ouattara, Lassina Traoré and Aboubacar Camara.

Argentina's friendlies against lower-ranked opponents in late 2025 were all wins: 1-0 v Venezuela (Oct 11), 6-0 v Puerto Rico (Oct 15) and 2-0 v Angola (Nov 14). Together with the 4-0 over Bolivia, that is 4 wins from 4. This is a small sample.
Under Scaloni, Argentina won 12, drew 2 and lost 4 of its 18 CONMEBOL World Cup qualifiers for 2026, finishing first.

market.question: Will the Atlanta Braves win the 2026 World Series?
market.rules:
This market will resolve according to the team that wins the 2026 MLB World Series. 

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed team to win the 2026 MLB World Series per the rules of MLB (e.g., they are eliminated in the playoffs), the corresponding market will resolve to “No”.

If the 2026 MLB season is cancelled, postponed after December 31, 2026 ET, or there is otherwise no winner declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from MLB (https://www.mlb.com/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

recent_facts.fact: The Dodgers won 100 games and are the two-time defending champions. As a division winner they got a first-round bye and are still alive. They face the Braves in the NLDS, after Atlanta beat Philadelphia 2-1 in the Wild Card Series.

NL bracket: No. 1 Brewers (103 wins) vs. No. 4 Padres, and No. 2 Dodgers vs. No. 3 Braves. AL bracket: No. 1 Rays vs. Yankees, and No. 2 Guardians vs. White Sox. The Padres, Yankees and White Sox all swept their Wild Card Series.

The best-of-five NLDS starts Saturday, Oct. 3, with the Dodgers hosting the Braves at 4 p.m. ET on Fox/FS1, and can run through about Oct. 9–10. The World Series starts Friday, Oct. 23, and would end by Oct. 31 if it goes seven games. To win, the Dodgers must take the NLDS (best of 5), the NLCS (best of 7) and the World Series (best of 7).
Dodgers NLDS rotation: Yoshinobu Yamamoto in Game 1, Blake Snell in Game 2, and Tarik Skubal in Game 3 at Atlanta.

Shohei Ohtani came off the 15-day IL for the final homestand and said he would 'most likely' not pitch again this season. He hit 5-for-21 with 8 strikeouts in his last five games, and he missed Thursday's team workout and simulated game.

Ohtani hit .275 with an .889 OPS and 30 HR in the regular season. GM Brandon Gomes said everything 'is feeling great physically,' and manager Dave Roberts called Ohtani 'as healthy as he's been in quite some time.'

Injuries have thinned Atlanta's rotation. Its Game 1 starter is TBD, Chris Sale can't pitch before Game 2, and Tyler Mahle and Martín Pérez can't pitch before Game 3. Bryce Elder (knee surgery) is out for the series. The Dodgers expect Ohtani and Freddie Freeman to be healthier after the five-day layoff, and RHP Edgardo Henriquez is set to return from a back injury.

Bye teams in the Division Series under the current format (2022–2025): 2 of 4 won in 2022, 1 of 4 in 2023, 3 of 4 in 2024, and reportedly 3 of 4 in 2025, for about 9 of 16 overall. That is only 16 series, and the 2025 count comes from search summaries, so treat it as unverified. The 2022 Dodgers, a bye team, lost in the NLDS.
In the Wild Card era, the team with the best regular-season record won the World Series 7 times in 29 seasons (24.1%). The 2026 Dodgers (100 wins) did not have MLB's best record; the Brewers won 103.

The Dodgers are trying to win a third straight title. From memory, and unverified: the last MLB team to win three in a row was the 1998–2000 Yankees, and no team has won three straight in the 12-team playoff format that began in 2022.

recent_facts.fact: At the official UFC 332 weigh-ins on Oct 2, 2026, Payton Talbott came in at 136.0 lbs and Deiveson Figueiredo at 135.5 lbs, so both made weight for the bantamweight bout (non-title fights allow a 1 lb allowance). No change to the bout was reported.
UFC 332 takes place Saturday, Oct 3, 2026, at the Delta Center in Salt Lake City and airs on Paramount+. Official weigh-ins were set for Friday, Oct 2.
Talbott is 11-1 as a pro and is 28 years old (born 1998-09-09). He is 5'10" with a 70.5" reach, and his wins break down as 7 KO/TKO, 1 submission and 3 decisions.

Talbott's last three fights: a unanimous-decision loss to Raoni Barcelos (Jan 18, 2025), then unanimous-decision wins over Felipe Lima (Jun 28, 2025) and former two-division champion Henry Cejudo (Dec 6, 2025). He has not fought since December 2025, about 10 months.

Figueiredo is 25-7-1 and is 38 years old (born 1987-12-18). Since moving up to bantamweight he is 4-4: wins over Rob Font, Cody Garbrandt, Marlon Vera and Montel Jackson (split decision), and losses to Petr Yan, Cory Sandhagen, Umar Nurmagomedov and Song Yadong.

Figueiredo's most recent fight was a loss to Song Yadong by guillotine choke at 4:42 of round 2 on May 30, 2026, about four months before UFC 332. Before that he lost a unanimous decision to Umar Nurmagomedov on Jan 24, 2026, so he has lost two straight and 4 of his last 5.

Figueiredo's last 8 fights: 4 wins and 4 losses. All 4 wins came in 2023–2025, and 4 of the 8 fights were losses against top-ranked bantamweights (Yan, Sandhagen, Nurmagomedov, Song). The Sandhagen loss in May 2025 was a TKO due to a knee injury in round 2.

Sherdog's Oct 1 preview says Talbott's loss to Barcelos came from wrestling, and that he worked on his defensive wrestling before beating Lima and Cejudo. It describes Figueiredo as a low-output power puncher who is 'no longer a one-shot knockout artist' at bantamweight.
Yahoo lists Talbott at 5-1 in the UFC and Figueiredo at 14-7-1 in the UFC, and describes Figueiredo as having hit a rough stretch since moving up to bantamweight at the end of 2023.

market.question: Will the ECB announce no change at the October 2026 meeting?
market.rules:
This market will resolve according to the change in basis points in the deposit facility rate resulting from the October 2026 meeting of the European Central Bank, relative to the level it was prior to this meeting.

The resolution source will be official information from the European Central Bank, including the statement or release from its October 2026 meeting, scheduled for October 28-29, 2026, as listed on the official European Central Bank calendar (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/calendars/mgcgc/html/index.en.html). This market may resolve as soon as the statement or release of the European Central Bank's October 2026 meeting with relevant data is issued.

If the specified rate is defined by an upper and lower bound, the relevant change will be the change to the upper bound.

If the specified rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded according to the following guidelines. Increases or decreases of less than 25 bps will be rounded to 25 bps (e.g. an increase or decrease of 10 bps would be considered to be an increase or decrease of 25 bps). Increases or decreases of greater than 25 bps will be rounded to the nearest 25 bps and will be rounded away from 0 in cases of equidistance (e.g., an increase or decrease of 37.5 bps would be considered to be an increase or decrease of 50 bps). Displayed options of “Increase” or “Decrease” will include policy rate increases or decreases of any size.

If the specified meeting is postponed to a date and time before the start of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve based on the outcome of that postponed meeting. If the specified meeting is cancelled, or postponed such that no decision is announced by the start of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the “No Change” bracket. Emergency changes to the specified rate not resulting from the specified meeting will not be considered.

recent_facts.fact: On 10 September 2026 the ECB raised all three key rates by 25 bps, taking the deposit facility rate to 2.50%, the MRO rate to 2.65% and the marginal lending rate to 2.90%. Lagarde called the unanimous decision 'a no-brainer'. The October decision will be measured against the 2.50% deposit rate.

The ECB said it follows 'a data-dependent and meeting-by-meeting approach' and is 'not pre-committing to a particular rate path'. Lagarde said the Council did not debate any future path and that future action 'will be determined at each and every meeting'.

Flash euro-area HICP inflation rose to 3.8% in September from 3.2% in August, above the 3.6% consensus and the highest in three years. The rise was driven by fuel, natural gas and food. Core inflation edged up to 2.5% from 2.4%.

Capital Economics' Jack Allen-Reynolds said the September data don't change the firm's view that the ECB is most likely to wait until December for its next hike. He added that an October hike 'would not be a big surprise' if energy prices rose further in the coming weeks.

Lagarde said 'measured' hikes remain appropriate: 'We see higher inflation ahead but no signs yet that it is becoming embedded', and there is no evidence yet that energy prices are feeding into wages. She pushed back on the idea that rates will automatically track energy costs. Economists read this as spacing hikes several months apart, which points more toward December than 29 October.
ECB Governing Council member Alexander Demarco (Malta) backed an October hike, citing firm core inflation as grounds for further action.

Ahead of the October vote, ECB Governing Council member Olli Rehn said the AI-related debt glut is doing part of the ECB's tightening work. In the same vein, Lagarde said higher bond yields since the September meeting would dampen growth and inflation.
On the day of the September hike, Bloomberg reported that ECB officials expect more tightening and that an October move is 'in play'.

Bundesbank President Joachim Nagel said it is too early to speculate about the next meeting. He added that rates may eventually need to move into mildly restrictive territory, depending on how energy prices develop. (The publication date is approximate.)

In the current cycle the ECB has gone hike, hold, hike. It made its first hike since 2023 in June 2026 (deposit rate to 2.25%), held unanimously on 23 July 2026, then hiked again on 10 September. So far it has not raised rates at two meetings in a row.

According to the account of the July meeting, the pause was not meant as the end of tightening, and some members would not have opposed a hike. Members also cited elevated uncertainty and said the full inflationary effect of the energy shock had yet to appear.

A qualifying announcement must express that the pipeline is presently operating; operation at partial or reduced capacity qualifies.

Once a qualifying announcement is made, this market will resolve to “Yes,” regardless of any subsequent contradictory statements, or alternative information from other sources.

recent_facts.fact: In a late-September article, AGBI reported that oil was flowing again through the East-West pipeline at about 3.5 million bpd, roughly half its pre-attack volume, citing Bloomberg and the Wall Street Journal. It said neither the Saudi Energy Ministry nor Saudi Aramco had made any public statement on the pipeline since the attack. The publication date is approximate; the article page itself could not be opened.

On Sept 22, Reuters reported that Saudi Arabia had restarted the East-West pipeline and could resume exports from Yanbu, citing three unnamed sources briefed on the matter. This was not an official Saudi government announcement.

Reports of the restart said the pipeline was pumping at a low rate and Aramco was working to bring flows back to about 4 million bpd, which could take weeks. Aramco had not publicly confirmed the throughput.

As of its Sept 29 update, the Wikipedia article says the pipeline restarted at very low volume on Sept 22 and will likely need at least 6–8 weeks to regain full capacity. The only Ministry of Energy statement it cites is the Sept 11 shutdown confirmation.

On Sept 11, the Ministry of Energy, via SPA, announced that the East-West pipeline had been shut down 'as a precaution' after multiple drone attacks on pumping stations in the Riyadh and Medina regions on Sept 10–11. The drones were launched from Iraq.
US Energy Secretary Chris Wright told CNBC that the pipeline closure would be a brief interruption lasting days. He is a third party, not the Saudi government.
The pipeline has 7 million bpd of capacity and had been carrying 4–5 million bpd to Red Sea terminals to get around Hormuz disruption. After the shutdown, Brent rose to about $108.

Precedent from earlier this year: after attacks on Saudi energy facilities, the Ministry of Energy officially announced on April 12, 2026 that the East-West pipeline was back to full pumping capacity of about 7 million bpd. That shows the ministry has publicly announced pipeline restorations before. This is a single case.

In the April episode, SPA had reported 'last week' that attacks cut pipeline output by 700,000 bpd, and the ministry announced full restoration on April 12. That puts the gap between the official damage report and the official restoration announcement at roughly one week or a little more. The exact attack dates are not given.

On Sept 30, CNBC reported that crude exports through the Strait of Hormuz were back at pre-war levels, while fuel shipments were still limited. That reduces how much Saudi Arabia depends on the Red Sea route for now.

Only an official Saudi government announcement that the pipeline is operating now, even at reduced capacity, counts, and it must come before Oct 31, 11:59 PM ET. Media reports citing unnamed sources, such as the Sept 22 Reuters story, do not count, and neither do statements that operation is planned or expected.

market.question: Will Flávio Bolsonaro win the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election by less than 5%?
market.rules:
A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the margin of victory between the top two candidates in the first round of the next Brazil Presidential Election.

For the purpose of this market, the “margin of victory” is defined as the absolute difference between the percentages of valid votes received by the first- and second-place candidates. Percentages of the valid votes received by each candidate will be determined by dividing the total number of valid votes each of the top two candidates receives by the sum of all valid votes cast in the election.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

This market will resolve based on the official vote count once the vote count has been made official.

If a recount is initiated before the vote total has been made official, the market will remain open until the recount is completed and the vote is made official.

If the result of this election isn't known definitively by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).

market.question: US announces end of Iranian blockade by October 15, 2026?
market.rules:
On July 13, 2026, Trump announced the United States would reinstate its naval blockade of Iran, targeting Iranian ships and customers.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if the United States government, or an authorized representative of the United States government, publicly and officially announces the end, termination, lifting, or suspension of the United States’ naval blockade on Iranian ships and ships of Iranian customers, between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

An announcement qualifies if it communicates that the United States will generally cease blocking vessel traffic for Iranian ships and customers, including an announcement that the blockade will not take effect at all, even if some restrictions remain (for example, an imposition of fees). An announcement does not qualify if it reflects only a limited or partial change that stops short of a general end or suspension of the blockade, for example, an exemption for a specific vessel, cargo, or port.

A qualifying announcement must be a declarative statement of the United States government’s present termination or suspension of the blockade, previously-unannounced prior termination or suspension of the blockade, or definitive decision to terminate or suspend the blockade.

A qualifying announcement must clearly and unambiguously identify the end or suspension of the blockade. Statements that merely allude to, reference, or describe an end to the blockade, without clearly communicating it, do not qualify. The announcement need not use specific terminology or reference the end of a blockade by name; an announcement of a resumption of prior obligations, the maintenance of a status quo, or a return to a previously agreed baseline qualifies, provided the substantive policy of ending or suspending the blockade is clearly and unambiguously communicated.

A qualifying announcement must be made through official channels, by an individual acting in an official capacity. Statements made incidentally or informally in a context not intended for official communication do not qualify.

The following do not qualify:

Anonymous, unattributed, or leaked statements not confirmed as official;
Statements by persons not authorized to speak for the United States government;
Third-party speculation, analysis, or predictions that the United States government will announce or implement an end to the blockade;
Satirical, fabricated, hacked, or impersonated communications; and
Statements that describe a prospective, contingent, probable, or conditional end to the blockade rather than announcing a present and decided position.

Once a qualifying announcement is made, this market will resolve to “Yes” regardless of whether it is later reversed, or whether the blockade actually ends in practice.

Resolution will be based on official information from the United States government, including the President, the Department of Defense, the Department of State, and United States Central Command (CENTCOM), or the official representatives of the United States government.

recent_facts.fact: On Oct 1-2, Trump said Iran is "ready to fold up" and suggested the war would end "right after the election," though he added it could end sooner. He said "We blow them up or make a deal." The US is keeping its maritime blockade of Iranian ports in place.

On Oct 1, Trump said Iran's latest peace proposal, which included terms for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, was not enough. He said the US would decide "very soon" whether to strike Iran or negotiate. Iran received Washington's response to its seven-day Hormuz proposal through Qatari mediators.

Trump rejected Iran's seven-day ceasefire plan, saying it "would not be acceptable." Under the plan, the US would lift its blockade of Iranian ports and unfreeze Iranian funds, and Iran would reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days. FM Araghchi said "only a negotiated solution" can end the deadlock.

US and Iranian officials held talks on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York, mediated by Qatar, Pakistan and Egypt. Iran proposed a regionwide ceasefire of up to 60 days, a phased reopening of Hormuz and an end to the US blockade.
Iran's stated conditions for talks with the US are an end to the war on all fronts, the unfreezing of Iranian funds, and an end to the naval blockade.

Iran loaded no crude onto tankers in September 2026, down from about 250,000 bpd in August, the first time this has happened since the war began in February. Kpler and Vortexa also recorded zero loadings.

Treasury imposed new sanctions on Iran's rail and automotive sectors under "Operation Economic Outcast." Three tankers were struck by unknown projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz on Sept 30, and Trump told TIME he doesn't believe "you could ever have peace" with Iran.

The reinstated blockade took effect on July 14, 2026 at 20:00 GMT. By Aug 11, CENTCOM had redirected 55 vessels, and by Sept 12 more than 100 vessels had been redirected since reinstatement. Several tankers (Belma, Lavine, Vela Nova) were disabled.

The previous precedent: the first blockade began April 13, 2026, and was lifted on June 18, 2026, when CENTCOM announced its removal about 66 days later. This came after a deal announced June 14 and signed at Versailles, which started a 60-day clock for a final deal. The blockade was reinstated about 4 weeks later. This is a single case and should not be read as a statistical base rate.

In April 2026, Trump rejected an earlier Iranian proposal and told Axios he would "maintain the blockade in order to pressure Tehran toward a nuclear agreement." The blockade was lifted only after a signed agreement about 7 weeks later.
The June ceasefire/MOU collapsed in less than three weeks, with Iran accusing the US of violating its terms. Trump announced the blockade's reinstatement on July 13.

The US midterm elections are on Nov 3, 2026, after the question closes on Oct 31. Trump has tied resuming strikes or ending the war to the period after the election. Talks through Qatari and Pakistani mediators are ongoing.

market.question: Next US-Iran senior diplomatic meeting by October 31, 2026? (copy)
market.rules:
On September 22, U.S. Special Envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York, with President Trump saying another meeting is scheduled in the near future.(see: https://www.israelhayom.com/2026/09/22/witkoff-kushner-attended-us-iran-meeting-another-expected-soon). 

This market will resolve to “Yes” if there is a direct or indirect senior-level diplomatic meeting between the United States and Iran by the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A diplomatic meeting occurs when representatives of both listed countries who are acting in an official capacity and are authorized to engage in diplomacy on behalf of their respective governments or governing authorities deliberately meet for the purpose of diplomacy or negotiation. A qualifying meeting need not result in any agreement, joint statement, or further engagement.

A diplomatic meeting is senior-level if each listed entity is represented by a head of state, a head of government, or a vice president; a foreign minister; a minister of cabinet rank; the secretary or head of a national security council; the presiding officer of a national legislature; a special envoy; or another individual designated by the head of state or head of government to conduct diplomatic negotiations on their behalf. Individuals authorized only for technical, implementation, monitoring, staff-level, preparatory, or working-group-level talks will not be considered designated to conduct diplomatic negotiations on behalf of the head of state or head of government. This definition includes, but is not limited to, all of the following individuals: for the United States, Donald Trump, JD Vance, Marco Rubio, Scott Bessent, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner; and for Iran, Mojtaba Khamenei, Masoud Pezeshkian, Abbas Araghchi and Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf. In each case, a qualifying representative must participate in the meeting.

A direct meeting refers to a diplomatic meeting where the representatives of both countries directly interact with each other in person. Meetings conducted through translators qualify, provided direct, face-to-face communication occurs. An indirect meeting refers to a meeting conducted indirectly through designated mediators or facilitators. A qualifying indirect meeting must meet both of the following criteria (i) the designated intermediaries act with the knowledge and authorization of both entities; (ii) representatives of both entities are physically present in the same facility, venue, or city as part of a single organized round of talks convened for the purpose of diplomatic engagement, with the intermediary conveying communications between the representatives or delegations on the same day. “The same day” means the same calendar day local time at the meeting location.

Sessions, proceedings, or convenings of standing international organizations, treaty bodies, or recurring multilateral summits or conferences (e.g., the United Nations General Assembly, G7, and G20 summits) do not qualify, unless a qualifying and deliberate diplomatic meeting between representatives of the listed countries is separately held alongside such a convening.

The following do not qualify as either a direct or indirect diplomatic meeting: chance encounters; standalone exchanges limited to greetings, courtesies, or photo opportunities; meetings conducted remotely, by telephone, or by any other means where the relevant representatives are not physically present at the same facility, venue, or city on the same day; discussions involving persons not authorized to engage in diplomacy or negotiation on behalf of their respective governments.

The resolution sources for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran and a consensus of credible reporting.

Temporary, interim, or placeholder mayors appointed before the election will not be considered.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting; however, if there is any ambiguity in the results, this market will resolve according to official information from the Peruvian government, including the National Jury of Elections (Jurado Nacional de Elecciones, JNE, https://jne.gob.pe) and the National Office of Electoral Processes (Oficina Nacional de Procesos Electorales, ONPE, https://www.onpe.gob.pe/).

recent_facts.fact: Ipsos said Allison had rebounded from 9% in its August 2026 poll to 13% in late September.
CIT's late poll had López Aliaga 33.4%, Bruce 12.0% and Allison 11.8%. In an earlier CIT poll (June 14–16) that left López Aliaga out, Allison led with 15.8%.
The Lima mayoral race is decided in a single round with no runoff, so the candidate with the most votes wins. There are 26 candidates.

López Aliaga, who was Lima's mayor until 2025, is registered as first councillor (primer regidor) on Renovación Popular's list. The list's mayoral nominee resigned, which makes him first in line to become mayor. Critics call this a disguised re-election that gets around the constitutional ban on immediate re-election.
The JNE (National Jury of Elections) confirmed López Aliaga's candidacy and rejected an appeal to exclude him. It said no challenge had been filed within the three-day deadline.
Days before the vote, the JNE had still not said whether it would give López Aliaga the mayor's credential if his list wins. APRA candidate Mónica Yaya asked Congress to call the JNE in to clarify.
Carlos Bruce took his complaint about a possible disguised re-election of López Aliaga to the OAS (Organization of American States).

Allison has been mayor of Magdalena del Mar for several terms over about 20 years and was briefly Housing Minister under Alan García. He was once arrested in the US for carrying more than $50,000 in cash and pleaded guilty to smuggling and perjury charges.
Allison said that if elected he would audit López Aliaga's administration, saying there were 'very clear signs of corruption'.
Campaigning closed on Oct 2. The municipal election is on Sunday, October 4, 2026, and ONPE (the national elections office) will publish the official count afterwards.

In 2018, Jorge Muñoz polled only 3.5% in Datum's final poll 11 days before the vote, yet went from fifth to first in the last week and won about 32% to Urresti's 21%. Reggiardo, who had led the polls, finished third with about 10%. (A single example; how often late reversals happen in Lima is unverified.)

recent_facts.fact: BLS reported that CPI-U all items rose 3.4% before seasonal adjustment in the 12 months ending August 2026, the same as July's 3.4%. The non-seasonally-adjusted (NSA) index for August 2026 was 334.980 (1982-84=100).

recent_facts.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (via DOL)
recent_facts.fact: In September 2025, CPI-U rose 0.3% seasonally adjusted. The NSA index went from 323.976 in August 2025 to 324.800 in September 2025, about +0.25% (my calculation). That month drops out of the 12-month window.
BLS has scheduled the September 2026 CPI release for Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET, the same day the question closes.

Seasonally adjusted monthly CPI changes in 2026: May -0.4%, June +0.1%, July +0.4%, August +0.4%. Core CPI rose 0.3% in August and 2.4% over 12 months. Energy was up 16.3% and gasoline up 27.4% over 12 months.
In August 2026, gasoline rose 3.9% seasonally adjusted, after -2.9% in July. It accounted for more than one third of August's all-items increase. Energy rose 2.1% and food 0.1% for the month.

The AAA national average for regular gasoline averaged $4.33 in September 2026, a record for September, 50 cents above the previous September record ($3.83 in 2023). It rose from $4.14 on September 3 to $4.27 on September 10, $4.43 on September 17 and $4.48 on September 24, and was $4.396 on October 2.

The national average gas price averaged about $4.06 per gallon in August 2026, a record for August. The national average was above $4 every day of the month. Against September's $4.33 average, that is roughly a 6.7% month-over-month rise in pump prices (my calculation).
EIA weekly U.S. regular gasoline prices: $4.319 on 2026-09-14, $4.478 on 2026-09-21 and $4.465 on 2026-09-28.
As of September 17, 2026, the national average gas price was more than one dollar higher than a year earlier.

facts_dropped.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (via DOL)
facts_dropped.fact: The September 2025 NSA CPI-U index was 324.800, 3.0% above September 2024. This is the base for the September 2026 12-month change. My own arithmetic, not a source figure: a published 3.6% or higher needs a September 2026 NSA index of about 336.33 or more, which is a roughly 0.40% NSA rise from August's 334.980. An index between about 336.01 and 336.32 would publish as 3.5%.

market.question: Will CPI rise more than 0.4% in September 2026? (Above 0.4%)
market.rules:
If the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increases by more than 0.4% (single-decimal) in September 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
The market will always close at 8:25 AM ET on the scheduled day of the data release (October 14, 2026). Please note: the Expiration Value is the single-decimal value published at the Source Agency. In the case of a delay in data caused by a federal government shutdown impacting the reliability of the Source Agency, the market’s latest Expiration Date will be extended to the sooner of the release of the Underlying or six months after the end of the government shutdown.

recent_facts.fact: Seasonally adjusted CPI-U rose 0.4% in August 2026, after 0.1% in July. Over 12 months, before seasonal adjustment, it was up 3.4%. In August, energy rose 2.1%, food 0.1%, core 0.3% and shelter 0.3%.

August 2026 gasoline rose 3.9% seasonally adjusted but only 2.5% before adjustment, so seasonal adjustment added to the gasoline gain. Gasoline accounted for over one third of the 0.4% all-items increase.

AAA's national average for regular gasoline was $4.14 on Sept 3, $4.27 on Sept 10, $4.43 on Sept 17 and $4.48 on Sept 24, then $4.396 on Oct 2. AAA said $4.48 was the highest ever for that time of year, driven by volatility in the Strait of Hormuz and high crude prices.

AAA's September 2026 monthly average gas price was reported as $4.33, a record for September and 50 cents above the previous September record. The figure came from a search summary; the AAA page that was read did not state a monthly average.
AAA's August 2026 monthly average gas price was $4.06/gal, a record for August. On this basis, September's $4.33 average would be about 6.7% higher than August before seasonal adjustment.
The question resolves on the single-decimal seasonally adjusted all-items CPI-U monthly change. 'More than 0.6%' requires a published 0.7% or higher; a published 0.6% would resolve No.
The September 2026 CPI report is scheduled for Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET.
Congress passed a continuing resolution funding the government through December 11, 2026 (House vote 370-48; Senate 90-6), so no shutdown began on October 1, 2026.
Monthly seasonally adjusted headline CPI in 2026: March +0.9%, April +0.6%, May +0.5%, June -0.4%, July +0.1%, August +0.4%. Only 1 of these 6 months (March) was above 0.6%.
In March 2026, CPI rose 0.9% seasonally adjusted. Gasoline rose 21.2%, its largest monthly rise since 1967, and energy rose 10.9%. Nearly three-quarters of the headline increase came from gasoline.
Energy-to-headline comparisons in 2026: April energy +3.8% came with a 0.6% headline (core +0.4%), and May energy +3.9% came with a 0.5% headline (core +0.2%).

recent_facts.fact: UFC 332 is set for October 3, 2026 at the Delta Center in Salt Lake City. Natália Silva vs. Wang Cong for the vacant UFC Women's Flyweight Championship is the main event. Three days before the event, a different bout on the card (Marcus McGhee's) changed opponents because of injury. No change to the main event was reported.

The title fight was originally Valentina Shevchenko vs. Silva. Shevchenko withdrew with a ligament injury to her back and shoulder that needs about a year of recovery, so the title was vacated. Wang Cong replaced her, and the bout moved from co-main event to main event.

recent_facts.source: Search summary of CBS Sports / UFC.com coverage
recent_facts.fact: A weigh-in report says Silva came in at 125 lb on Friday (Oct 2), making the title limit. I could not confirm Wang's official weight. One coach said Wang has struggled to make championship weight before. The 125.5 lb figure listed for her is from her July fight with Tracy Cortez, which was a non-title bout.

Wang Cong's pro record is 10-1: 2 wins by KO, 2 by submission, 6 by decision. Her only loss was a rear-naked choke submission to Gabriella Fernandes at UFC Fight Night 248 on 2024-11-23. This is her first title shot.

Wang's last four fights were all unanimous-decision wins: Bruna Brasil (UFC 312, 2025-02-09), Ariane da Silva (UFC 316, 2025-06-07, catchweight after da Silva missed weight), Eduarda Moura (2026-02-07) and Tracy Cortez (UFC 329, 2026-07-11). Before those, she knocked out Victoria Leonardo in 62 seconds on 2024-08-24.
Natália Silva is on a 14-fight winning streak, 8-0 in the UFC. This is her first UFC main event.

Silva's most recent fight was a unanimous decision (29-28 x3) over Rose Namajunas at UFC 324 on 2026-01-24. The decision was disputed: 13 of 18 media scorers had Namajunas winning, and the crowd booed Silva. She has not fought since, a gap of about 8 months.

Silva is 29 and has a taekwondo background. UFC.com lists her takedown defense, 90.3%, as the division's best. Her UFC wins include Alexa Grasso, Jéssica Andrade, Viviane Araújo, Andrea Lee and Namajunas. Before the UFC she had six straight submission wins, five by armbar.

Wang is 34 and has a kickboxing background, including a 2015 pro kickboxing win over Valentina Shevchenko. UFC.com lists her significant-strike accuracy, 58.2%, as the division's best, and she is second in the division in strikes landed per minute (8).
On Saturday Oct 3, 2026, early prelims start at 4pm ET, prelims at 6pm ET and the main card at 8pm ET on CBS/Paramount. The title fight headlines the card and is scheduled for five rounds.

market.question: Will Elmano de Freitas win the 2026 Ceará gubernatorial election?
market.rules:
The Ceará gubernatorial election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026, with a runoff on October 25, 2026, if no candidate receives a majority of the valid votes in the first round.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

Temporary, interim, or placeholder governors appointed by any means before the specified election will not be considered.

recent_facts.fact: O Povo's weighted average of polls as of Sept 28 put Ciro Gomes (PSDB) at 44.57% and Governor Elmano de Freitas (PT) at 43.83% for the first round. All other candidates combined polled about 2%.

Datafolha (1,204 voters, Sept 22–24, ±3 pts) had Ciro at 44% and Elmano at 43% in total votes, or 49% to 48% in valid votes. That leaves neither above the 50% needed to win in the first round. In a runoff, Ciro had 48% and Elmano 46%, down from an 8-point Ciro lead in the previous Datafolha poll.
Quaest (900 voters, ±3 pts) had Ciro at 43% and Elmano at 41% in the first round, with 14% undecided or blank. In a runoff, Ciro had 45% and Elmano 42%.

Paraná Pesquisas (1,352 voters in 59 municipalities, Sept 23–25, ±2.7 pts) had Ciro at 46.0% and Elmano at 42.2%. In valid votes that is Ciro 50.8% and Elmano 46.5%. The same poll found 57.7% approval of Elmano's government.
RealTime Big Data (released Sept 26) had Elmano at 48% and Ciro at 41% in the first round, with 8% undecided or blank.

market.question: Will Lula win 44% or more of the valid vote in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
market.rules:
A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the percentage of valid votes received by Luis Inácio (Lula) da Silva in the first round of this election.

The percentage of valid votes received by the specified candidate will be determined by dividing the total number of valid votes the candidate receives in the first round by the sum of all valid votes cast in the first round.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

If the specified candidate does not appear on the ballot in the first round, or otherwise receives no valid votes, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

This market will resolve based on the official vote count.

If a recount is initiated before the vote total has been made official, the market will remain open until the recount is completed and the vote is made official.

If the result of this election isn't known definitively by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, including the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).

recent_facts.source: Jornal do Brasil (Datafolha poll for Folha/TV Globo)
recent_facts.fact: Datafolha interviewed 2,506 voters from Sept 28 to Oct 1, 2026. In valid votes it had Lula (PT) at 45%, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) 40%, Augusto Cury 4%, Caiado 3%, Renan Santos 3%, and Zema, Samara Martins and Wilson Grassi at 1% each. In total votes it was Lula 42%, Flávio 38%.

recent_facts.source: Gazeta do Povo (Real Time Big Data poll)
recent_facts.fact: Real Time Big Data's poll, released Oct 1 (fieldwork Sept 26–30), had Lula at 46% of valid votes and Flávio Bolsonaro at 41% in the first round. In total votes it was 43% to 39%.

AtlasIntel's Sept 23–28 poll had Lula at 46.2% of valid votes and Flávio Bolsonaro at 43.1%, with total votes of 45.3% to 42.2%. A Terra headline on another AtlasIntel release gave valid votes of 46.3% to 43.9%.

Nine polls came out from Sept 28 onward. Lula's total-vote shares were: Vox Brasil (Sept 29–Oct 1) 40.4% to Flávio's 41.2%, Datafolha 42%, Real Time Big Data 43%, Meio/Ideia 39.4% (Flávio 38.4%), AtlasIntel 45.3%, Gerp 40% (Flávio 42%), Quaest 39% and BTG/Nexus 42% (Flávio 37%). Lula is numerically ahead in 7 and Flávio in 2.

In 2022, Datafolha's final first-round poll (12,800 interviews, Sept 30–Oct 1) had Lula at 50% of valid votes and Bolsonaro at 36%. The official result was Lula 48.4% and Bolsonaro 43.2%. That means Datafolha overstated Lula by about 1.6 points and understated Bolsonaro by about 7 points. This is a single cycle, one pollster.
Lula received 48.43% of valid votes in the 2022 first round. Unverified from memory: he also won 48.6% in 2006 and 46.4% in 2002.

AtlasIntel's final first-round poll (5,000 online interviews, Sept 27–Oct 2) will be published on the eve of the election. A final Quaest poll (3,702 interviews, Oct 2–3) has also been reported as still to come. The first round is on Oct 4, 2026.

market.question: Will Likud win the most seats in the 2026 Israeli legislative election?
market.rules:
Legislative elections are expected to be held in Israel on October 27, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the political party or coalition that wins the greatest number of seats in the Israeli Knesset as a result of this election.

If the results of this election are not definitively known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

In the event of a tie between multiple parties or coalitions for the most seats won, this market will resolve in favor of the party or coalition whose candidate list received a greater number of valid votes. In the event that results in a tie, this market will resolve in favor of the party whose listed name appears first in alphabetical order.

This market's resolution will be based solely on the number of seats won by the named party or coalition in the Israeli Knesset.

This market will resolve based on the election results, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by Israel’s Central Election Committee (Va'adet HaBehirot HaMerkazit) (https://www.gov.il/en/departments/central-elections-committee/govil-landing-page).

The following rules govern the merging, joint contention, and splitting of listed parties:

- If Likud or Together (or any successor party created through a merger) merge with or contest the election jointly with any other party, the option corresponding to Likud or Together will represent the resultant candidate list or merged party. 

Otherwise:

- If a listed party merges with, or contests the election as part of a joint candidate list with, one or more unlisted parties prior to the election, the option corresponding to the listed party will represent all seats won by the merged party or joint candidate list. If a listed party merges with, or contests the election as part of a joint candidate list with, one or more other listed parties prior to the election, the option corresponding to the party which held the most seats in the prior Knesset will represent all seats won by the merged party/joint candidate list. If these rules do not adequately determine which option represents a merged party or joint candidate list, the listed party whose name, as listed in this market, comes first in alphabetical order, will represent all seats won by the merged party or joint candidate list.

- If a listed party splits into multiple parties prior to the election, the option corresponding to the listed party will represent the resulting party that holds the greatest number of seats in the Israeli Knesset as a result of the split. If these rules do not adequately determine which party represents a listed option after a split, the listed option will represent all seats won by the party resulting from the split whose primary English name comes first in alphabetical order.

recent_facts.fact: In the Channel 13 poll published Sept 30/Oct 1, Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar was the largest party with 21 seats and Likud had 19. Bennett's Together and Golan's Democrats had 11 each, and the Netanyahu bloc had 54 seats against 52 for the Jewish opposition parties.

recent_facts.source: Wikipedia, Opinion polling for the 2026 Israeli legislative election
recent_facts.fact: In polls from Sept 29–30, Likud had 19 seats (Maagar Mochot), 19 (LRI+P4A), 19 (MP+TM+SN) and 21 (Yossi Tatika). The leading opposition party had 21 seats in each, so Likud placed second or tied for first. The table summary labeled that party 'Dems', which may be a mislabel for Yashar. A Sept 28 SF+ND poll (Channel 14) put Likud on top with 31.

recent_facts.source: Wikipedia, Opinion polling for the 2026 Israeli legislative election
recent_facts.fact: Of the 15 most recent polls (Sept 17–30), Likud led or tied for first in 5: all three SF+ND/Channel 14 polls (31, 32, 31), both Direct Polls/i24 polls (27, 27) and the Sept 30 Tatika tie at 21. In the other 9 or 10, Likud was second with 18–21 seats.

Poll roundup: Likud had 32 in Channel 14, 27 in i24NEWS, 18 in Maariv, 20 in N12 and 18 in Channel 13. Yashar had 22, 22, 22, 23 and 22. Averages were Likud 23 and Yashar 22.2, with Bennett's B'Yachad at 10.6.
Poll average on Sept 17: Yashar 22.2 seats, Likud 21.2 and B'Yachad 12.2. Likud had 20 (Kan), 18 (Ch13), 20 (Ch12), 30 (Ch14) and 18 (Ch16).
A recent five-poll roundup had Yashar first in 4 of 5 surveys: Kan 25–21, Maariv 24–23 and Channel 13 21–19. i24NEWS had Likud ahead 27–22. Averages were Yashar 23.6 and Likud 21.8.

Party lists closed on Sept 9, 2026. Likud filed its own list headed by Netanyahu, followed by Eli Cohen, Amir Ohana and Yariv Levin. Eisenkot's Yashar and Bennett's Together/B'Yachad filed separately.
Election day is Oct 27, 2026. The Central Elections Committee publishes official results, usually within about a week, and the question closes Oct 28.

recent_facts.source: Israel National News / Israel Elects analysis (via search summary)
recent_facts.fact: In 2015, final polls put Likud at about 22 seats, but it won 30, a miss of about 8 seats. Over 2015, 2020 and 2022, polls underestimated the right-wing bloc by an average of 5.71 seats and overestimated the left/center/Arab bloc by 2.52 (only 3 elections, so a small sample).

An Israel Elects analysis says Israel's main polls have overestimated left-leaning parties and underestimated the right over the past decade. In 2022, every pollster underestimated Shas and the Arab parties.

UNVERIFIED: Likud won the most seats, or tied and won on votes, in 6 of the 8 Knesset elections from 2009 to 2022 (2013, 2015, Apr 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022). The exceptions were 2009 (Kadima 28 to 27) and Sept 2019 (Blue and White 33 to 32).

recent_facts.fact: BTC was $84,502.31 at 8:04 pm EDT on Oct 2, 2026 (aggregate price, not Binance; about 1 day old by Oct 3). That is about 3.5% below $87,500, about 2.4% above $82,500 and about 5.3% above $80,000.

After the weak September jobs report at 8:30 a.m. EDT on Oct 2 (29,000 jobs vs about 90,000 expected), bitcoin briefly rose above $87,000. It then gave back about $2,000 to roughly $85,300–85,500 by the afternoon.

Bitcoin tapped roughly $87,200 on Friday, Oct 2, and could not extend past nearby multi-month highs. That high is about 0.3% below the $87,500 strike. It is unverified on Binance 1m candles, and none of the sources found reports a touch of $87,500 so far in October.
Bitcoin reclaimed $87,000 on Oct 2, the first time above that level since Sept 23.
BTC was $86,682.15 at 9:21 a.m. ET on Oct 2, up $3,234 from the previous day's $83,448.09 (aggregate price, not Binance). It was $77,302 one month earlier and $120,612 one year earlier.

BTC traded around $83,200 on Sept 30 and spent the last days of September between about $82,800 and $85,000. Without Binance confirmation, it is unverified whether October's opening hours went below $82,500; the Oct 1 reference price was about $83,448.
September 2026 closed near $83.6K, the highest monthly close of 2026. Reported highs were about $87.0–87.3K, around Sept 23 and earlier in the month.
In early September a hot August jobs report sent BTC below $80,000. Together with the roughly $87K high, September's range was about $77K–87K, or roughly 12–13% of price.

BTC was up 2.6% for the week to Oct 2, its third straight weekly gain, after a 6.4% rise in September (its third monthly gain in a row). Risks cited were US–Iran tensions and possible further rate hikes.

recent_facts.source: Yahoo Finance / search summary (perpetual futures order data)
recent_facts.fact: Large perpetual-futures sell orders sat near $86,900, $87,700 and $88,000. BlackRock's spot BTC ETF had about $195.6M of inflows in one day.
Bitcoin closed October higher in 10 of the past 13 years, with an average gain of 18.71%. This is a monthly-close statistic, not a measure of intramonth touches.
No same-day (Oct 3, a Saturday) macro catalyst was found. The latest price found is from the evening of Oct 2, about $84.5K, and the weekend may be quieter.

market.question: Will the Los Angeles Dodgers win the 2026 World Series?
market.rules:
This market will resolve according to the team that wins the 2026 MLB World Series. 

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed team to win the 2026 MLB World Series per the rules of MLB (e.g., they are eliminated in the playoffs), the corresponding market will resolve to “No”.

If the 2026 MLB season is cancelled, postponed after December 31, 2026 ET, or there is otherwise no winner declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from MLB (https://www.mlb.com/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

recent_facts.fact: The Dodgers won 100 games and are the two-time defending champions. As a division winner they got a first-round bye and are still alive. They face the Braves in the NLDS, after Atlanta beat Philadelphia 2-1 in the Wild Card Series.

NL bracket: No. 1 Brewers (103 wins) vs. No. 4 Padres, and No. 2 Dodgers vs. No. 3 Braves. AL bracket: No. 1 Rays vs. Yankees, and No. 2 Guardians vs. White Sox. The Padres, Yankees and White Sox all swept their Wild Card Series.

The best-of-five NLDS starts Saturday, Oct. 3, with the Dodgers hosting the Braves at 4 p.m. ET on Fox/FS1, and can run through about Oct. 9–10. The World Series starts Friday, Oct. 23, and would end by Oct. 31 if it goes seven games. To win, the Dodgers must take the NLDS (best of 5), the NLCS (best of 7) and the World Series (best of 7).
Dodgers NLDS rotation: Yoshinobu Yamamoto in Game 1, Blake Snell in Game 2, and Tarik Skubal in Game 3 at Atlanta.

Shohei Ohtani came off the 15-day IL for the final homestand and said he would 'most likely' not pitch again this season. He hit 5-for-21 with 8 strikeouts in his last five games, and he missed Thursday's team workout and simulated game.

Ohtani hit .275 with an .889 OPS and 30 HR in the regular season. GM Brandon Gomes said everything 'is feeling great physically,' and manager Dave Roberts called Ohtani 'as healthy as he's been in quite some time.'

Injuries have thinned Atlanta's rotation. Its Game 1 starter is TBD, Chris Sale can't pitch before Game 2, and Tyler Mahle and Martín Pérez can't pitch before Game 3. Bryce Elder (knee surgery) is out for the series. The Dodgers expect Ohtani and Freddie Freeman to be healthier after the five-day layoff, and RHP Edgardo Henriquez is set to return from a back injury.

Bye teams in the Division Series under the current format (2022–2025): 2 of 4 won in 2022, 1 of 4 in 2023, 3 of 4 in 2024, and reportedly 3 of 4 in 2025, for about 9 of 16 overall. That is only 16 series, and the 2025 count comes from search summaries, so treat it as unverified. The 2022 Dodgers, a bye team, lost in the NLDS.
In the Wild Card era, the team with the best regular-season record won the World Series 7 times in 29 seasons (24.1%). The 2026 Dodgers (100 wins) did not have MLB's best record; the Brewers won 103.

The Dodgers are trying to win a third straight title. From memory, and unverified: the last MLB team to win three in a row was the 1998–2000 Yankees, and no team has won three straight in the 12-team playoff format that began in 2022.

market.question: Israel accuses Iran/proxies of plane stabbing incident by Oct 31?
market.rules:
On September 30, 2026, FlyDubai flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv diverted to Saudi Arabia following an incident in the cockpit in which the co-pilot allegedly stabbed the captain. (see: https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/diverted-flydubai-flight-israel-was-not-hijacking-incident-israeli-prime-2026-09-30/).

This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Israeli national government, or an authorized representative of the Israeli national government, publicly announces that Iran or its affiliated groups deliberately caused this incident, by October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

A public announcement refers to an on-the-record statement issued by the Israeli national government or by its authorized representatives acting in an official capacity on behalf of the Israeli national government. A statement or press release issued by the Israeli national government or any of its agencies will qualify. A Prime Minister or Cabinet Minister’s public statements will always be considered to be issued on-the-record in a capacity representing the Israeli national government for purposes of this market. A statement from a lawmaker or other government official speaking in their own capacity or on behalf of a party not in government will not alone qualify.

For purposes of this market, an affiliated group of Iran is: any organization directly controlled by Iran, Hezbollah, Hamas, Palestinian Islamic Jihad, Houthis ("Ansar Allah"), Kata'ib Hezbollah, Asa'ib Ahl al-Haq, Badr Organization, and Harakat al-Nujaba. An unlisted group will only qualify if the Israeli claim itself, or accompanying statements or releases, specifies that the group is a proxy of or otherwise is controlled or directed by Iran. A general statement that it was conducted by an Iranian proxy will also qualify, even if no group is named.

Such a statement will be considered to claim that Iran or its affiliated groups deliberately caused the incident if it explicitly claims that Iran or an affiliated group ordered, carried out, planned, or otherwise directly aided or coordinated the incident. Statements that attribute only inspiration or ideological influence (e.g., "this would not have happened if Iran didn't radicalize terrorists," "the co-pilot was influenced by Hamas' ideas") will not qualify.

Once a qualifying announcement has been made, no subsequent walkback or retraction will be relevant for purposes of this market. 

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the Israeli national government; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

recent_facts.fact: Asked whether Iran was linked to the FlyDubai FZ1073 attack, Prime Minister Netanyahu said: "It's too early to say. The attacking pilot is now being investigated in Saudi Arabia." He said questioning had shown the co-pilot "underwent Islamist radical indoctrination."

A senior Israeli official said the co-pilot most likely acted alone. Two Israeli security officials told Reuters that no evidence of Iranian involvement had been found so far, and the initial assessment was that he acted independently. The investigation is still open.

Despite Trump's remarks, a senior Israeli official said on Thursday that investigators have so far ruled out an apparent connection to Iran. Reports describe a growing assessment that he acted alone for nationalist reasons. That assessment has not been confirmed.

Trump said he had reason to believe Iran was involved: "Based on what I'm hearing is yes, but we're working on it right now." Israeli officials said they currently have no indications of Iranian involvement but have not ruled it out.

Trump said the US would strike Iran "very hard" if a Tehran link were established, but he made no definitive accusation. An Israeli official said the co-pilot's social media showed he had been "radicalised into jihadist ideology" and talked about killing Jews. Reports say leaflets from "Free Palestine groups" were found with him, but no formal link to any organization has been confirmed.

Netanyahu's spokesman alleged the attack was meant to undermine the Abraham Accords and disrupt Israel's election. He gave no evidence and did not say whether the suspect was directed by Iran or any other organization.

The Omani co-pilot was suspended by Oman Air in 2024, when he was a co-pilot trainee, after extremist materials were found with him. He later joined FlyDubai, where he had worked for about 5 to 9 months.

After medical clearance, the suspect was moved from Saudi Arabia to Abu Dhabi. The UAE is leading the investigation and is examining whether the attack was terrorism, and whether he was a lone attacker or was directed by outside actors.

Israel, Oman, Saudi Arabia, the UAE and the United States have opened investigations, and the motive is still undetermined. No date has been announced for findings. The question closes on October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET.

Al Jazeera reports that the attack gives Netanyahu a new security message ahead of an upcoming Israeli election vote. This sets the political context in which Israeli government statements about the incident will be made.
The stabbing came in a region already shaken by a recent US-Iran war. Iran's state outlet Press TV called the incident a Netanyahu plot to drag the US into war with Iran.

market.question: Will Bitcoin be above $100000 by November 1, 2026 at 12:00AM ET? (Before November 2026)
market.rules:
If the Bitcoin spot price according to the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index is above $100000.00 starting Jul 21, 2026 and before Nov 1, 2026 at 12:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
The market resolves based on the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index (BRTI) using a trimmed mean calculation. The resolution value is calculated by taking all BRTI values for each minute from market issuance until the specified time on the target date, removing the top 20% and bottom 20% of values, then averaging the remaining 60% of values. If the BRTI crosses the threshold at any point during the measurement period (triggering early expiration), the market immediately resolves. If no data is available at the expiration time, the market resolves to No. The market can resolve early if Bitcoin definitively crosses the threshold before the target date and time.

market.question: US announces end of Iranian blockade by October 31, 2026?
market.rules:
On July 13, 2026, Trump announced the United States would reinstate its naval blockade of Iran, targeting Iranian ships and customers.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if the United States government, or an authorized representative of the United States government, publicly and officially announces the end, termination, lifting, or suspension of the United States’ naval blockade on Iranian ships and ships of Iranian customers, between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

An announcement qualifies if it communicates that the United States will generally cease blocking vessel traffic for Iranian ships and customers, including an announcement that the blockade will not take effect at all, even if some restrictions remain (for example, an imposition of fees). An announcement does not qualify if it reflects only a limited or partial change that stops short of a general end or suspension of the blockade, for example, an exemption for a specific vessel, cargo, or port.

A qualifying announcement must be a declarative statement of the United States government’s present termination or suspension of the blockade, previously-unannounced prior termination or suspension of the blockade, or definitive decision to terminate or suspend the blockade.

A qualifying announcement must clearly and unambiguously identify the end or suspension of the blockade. Statements that merely allude to, reference, or describe an end to the blockade, without clearly communicating it, do not qualify. The announcement need not use specific terminology or reference the end of a blockade by name; an announcement of a resumption of prior obligations, the maintenance of a status quo, or a return to a previously agreed baseline qualifies, provided the substantive policy of ending or suspending the blockade is clearly and unambiguously communicated.

A qualifying announcement must be made through official channels, by an individual acting in an official capacity. Statements made incidentally or informally in a context not intended for official communication do not qualify.

The following do not qualify:

Anonymous, unattributed, or leaked statements not confirmed as official;
Statements by persons not authorized to speak for the United States government;
Third-party speculation, analysis, or predictions that the United States government will announce or implement an end to the blockade;
Satirical, fabricated, hacked, or impersonated communications; and
Statements that describe a prospective, contingent, probable, or conditional end to the blockade rather than announcing a present and decided position.

Once a qualifying announcement is made, this market will resolve to “Yes” regardless of whether it is later reversed, or whether the blockade actually ends in practice.

Resolution will be based on official information from the United States government, including the President, the Department of Defense, the Department of State, and United States Central Command (CENTCOM), or the official representatives of the United States government.

recent_facts.fact: On Oct 1-2, Trump said Iran is "ready to fold up" and suggested the war would end "right after the election," though he added it could end sooner. He said "We blow them up or make a deal." The US is keeping its maritime blockade of Iranian ports in place.

On Oct 1, Trump said Iran's latest peace proposal, which included terms for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, was not enough. He said the US would decide "very soon" whether to strike Iran or negotiate. Iran received Washington's response to its seven-day Hormuz proposal through Qatari mediators.

Trump rejected Iran's seven-day ceasefire plan, saying it "would not be acceptable." Under the plan, the US would lift its blockade of Iranian ports and unfreeze Iranian funds, and Iran would reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days. FM Araghchi said "only a negotiated solution" can end the deadlock.

US and Iranian officials held talks on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York, mediated by Qatar, Pakistan and Egypt. Iran proposed a regionwide ceasefire of up to 60 days, a phased reopening of Hormuz and an end to the US blockade.
Iran's stated conditions for talks with the US are an end to the war on all fronts, the unfreezing of Iranian funds, and an end to the naval blockade.

Iran loaded no crude onto tankers in September 2026, down from about 250,000 bpd in August, the first time this has happened since the war began in February. Kpler and Vortexa also recorded zero loadings.

Treasury imposed new sanctions on Iran's rail and automotive sectors under "Operation Economic Outcast." Three tankers were struck by unknown projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz on Sept 30, and Trump told TIME he doesn't believe "you could ever have peace" with Iran.

The reinstated blockade took effect on July 14, 2026 at 20:00 GMT. By Aug 11, CENTCOM had redirected 55 vessels, and by Sept 12 more than 100 vessels had been redirected since reinstatement. Several tankers (Belma, Lavine, Vela Nova) were disabled.

The previous precedent: the first blockade began April 13, 2026, and was lifted on June 18, 2026, when CENTCOM announced its removal about 66 days later. This came after a deal announced June 14 and signed at Versailles, which started a 60-day clock for a final deal. The blockade was reinstated about 4 weeks later. This is a single case and should not be read as a statistical base rate.

In April 2026, Trump rejected an earlier Iranian proposal and told Axios he would "maintain the blockade in order to pressure Tehran toward a nuclear agreement." The blockade was lifted only after a signed agreement about 7 weeks later.
The June ceasefire/MOU collapsed in less than three weeks, with Iran accusing the US of violating its terms. Trump announced the blockade's reinstatement on July 13.

The US midterm elections are on Nov 3, 2026, after the question closes on Oct 31. Trump has tied resuming strikes or ending the war to the period after the election. Talks through Qatari and Pakistani mediators are ongoing.

market.question: Bab el-Mandeb Strait effectively closed by October 31?
market.rules:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if IMF PortWatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Bab el-Mandeb Strait less than or equal to 10 for any date between market creation and the listed date. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This market will resolve as soon as IMF PortWatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls for the Bab el-Mandeb Strait equal to or below 10, or once data has been published for the listed date and no such value has been published.

If no data has been published for the listed date within 14 calendar days (ET) after that date, this market will resolve based on the data published up to that point.

Revisions to previously published data points made before data has been published for the listed date will be considered; however, they will not disqualify a previously published data point from qualifying. Revisions made after data has been published for the listed date will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market will be IMF PortWatch, specifically the “Arrivals of Ships” data published for the Bab el-Mandeb Strait at https://portwatch.imf.org/pages/6b1814d64903461b98144a6cc25eb79c.

recent_facts.fact: Bab el-Mandeb transits were 290 for September 21–27 (preliminary) and 264 for September 14–20. The four-week average to late September was 280 a week, about 40 a day. This is Lloyd's List's own count, not PortWatch.

PortWatch monthly data show an average of 28 vessels a day in August 2026, the lowest monthly level in the recent series. A sample from September 9–11 averaged about 26 a day, and the 10-day average was about 27.

PortWatch daily averages: about 71 a day before the crisis (Jan 2022–Oct 2023), 43 a day from Nov 17, 2023 to Feb 19, 2024, about 33.5 a day in 2025, and 34–37 a day in Jan–Jun 2026. No reported monthly average since the Red Sea crisis began came close to 10 a day.
After the Houthi escalation in July 2026, Kpler's 7-day moving average fell from 34 a day in mid-July to 24 a day on July 29. That was the sharpest recent drop, and it stayed far above 10.

A search-result summary of this page said Bab el-Mandeb's seven-day average had been between 15 and 27 vessels a day, and had not reached 10 or below. The page was not opened, so its date and the exact period are unverified.

Single-day counts from other trackers fell to 11 transits on July 26, 2026, down from 31–39 a day on July 23–25, during the Houthi blockade escalation. These are daily figures from Kpler and Windward, not PortWatch 7-day averages.
After their September offensive took Yemen's Red Sea coast, Houthi forces were making intense attacks across frontlines in Taiz governorate.

By capturing Mokha, Perim (Mayun) Island in the middle of the strait, and the Zuqar and Hanish islands in mid-September 2026, the Houthis gained direct control of the Yemeni side of the 32 km-wide Bab el-Mandeb. Their attacks on shipping resumed in July 2026 after a pause of about six months.

EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said commercial vessels are effectively queuing for escorts because Operation Aspides does not have enough warships. VLCCs are again loading at Saudi Arabia's Yanbu as the Saudi pipeline comes back online.

Dallas lost 34-31 to Baltimore in Rio de Janeiro in Week 3 on Tyler Loop's 56-yard field goal on the final play, dropping the Cowboys to 1-2.

Houston lost 36-31 to Buffalo in Week 1. Dallas lost to the New York Giants in Week 1. A search summary gave the score as 28-20, but no page was read to confirm it, so treat that score as unverified.
Dallas has the NFL's 4th-ranked offense but ranks last in defensive EPA per play. Houston averages 3.6 yards per carry and 4.8 yards per play.

market.question: Saudi Oil Pipeline (East-West) restarts by October 15?
market.rules:
On September 11, 2026, Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Energy announced that the East-West oil pipeline has been shut down.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if the government of Saudi Arabia announces that the East-West oil pipeline is operational or no longer shut down between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A qualifying announcement must express that the pipeline is presently operating; operation at partial or reduced capacity qualifies.

Announcements that attribute such a claim to third parties, state that the pipeline will or may operate in the future, describe work underway to restore operation, or frame resumption as expected, planned, or conditional, will not qualify.

Once a qualifying announcement is made, this market will resolve to “Yes,” regardless of any subsequent contradictory statements, or alternative information from other sources.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the government of Saudi Arabia.

recent_facts.fact: In a late-September article, AGBI reported that oil was flowing again through the East-West pipeline at about 3.5 million bpd, roughly half its pre-attack volume, citing Bloomberg and the Wall Street Journal. It said neither the Saudi Energy Ministry nor Saudi Aramco had made any public statement on the pipeline since the attack. The publication date is approximate; the article page itself could not be opened.

On Sept 22, Reuters reported that Saudi Arabia had restarted the East-West pipeline and could resume exports from Yanbu, citing three unnamed sources briefed on the matter. This was not an official Saudi government announcement.

Reports of the restart said the pipeline was pumping at a low rate and Aramco was working to bring flows back to about 4 million bpd, which could take weeks. Aramco had not publicly confirmed the throughput.

As of its Sept 29 update, the Wikipedia article says the pipeline restarted at very low volume on Sept 22 and will likely need at least 6–8 weeks to regain full capacity. The only Ministry of Energy statement it cites is the Sept 11 shutdown confirmation.

On Sept 11, the Ministry of Energy, via SPA, announced that the East-West pipeline had been shut down 'as a precaution' after multiple drone attacks on pumping stations in the Riyadh and Medina regions on Sept 10–11. The drones were launched from Iraq.
US Energy Secretary Chris Wright told CNBC that the pipeline closure would be a brief interruption lasting days. He is a third party, not the Saudi government.
The pipeline has 7 million bpd of capacity and had been carrying 4–5 million bpd to Red Sea terminals to get around Hormuz disruption. After the shutdown, Brent rose to about $108.

Precedent from earlier this year: after attacks on Saudi energy facilities, the Ministry of Energy officially announced on April 12, 2026 that the East-West pipeline was back to full pumping capacity of about 7 million bpd. That shows the ministry has publicly announced pipeline restorations before. This is a single case.

In the April episode, SPA had reported 'last week' that attacks cut pipeline output by 700,000 bpd, and the ministry announced full restoration on April 12. That puts the gap between the official damage report and the official restoration announcement at roughly one week or a little more. The exact attack dates are not given.

On Sept 30, CNBC reported that crude exports through the Strait of Hormuz were back at pre-war levels, while fuel shipments were still limited. That reduces how much Saudi Arabia depends on the Red Sea route for now.

Only an official Saudi government announcement that the pipeline is operating now, even at reduced capacity, counts, and it must come before Oct 31, 11:59 PM ET. Media reports citing unnamed sources, such as the Sept 22 Reuters story, do not count, and neither do statements that operation is planned or expected.
