This market will resolve to "Yes" if there is a military encounter between the military forces of a NATO country and Russia between market creation and October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

A "military encounter" is defined as any incident involving the use of force such as missile strikes, artillery fire, exchange of gunfire, or other forms of direct military engagement between NATO and Russian military forces. Non-violent actions, such as airspace violations, firing of warning shots (such as the June, 2021 Black Sea Confrontations between Russian forces and HMS Defender), or cyberattacks will not qualify.

Interception of missiles or other one-way attack or loitering munitions (e.g. Shahed drones) which are targeting a 3rd party other than the listed countries or their respective forces will not alone qualify. Shooting down UAVs which are not munitions (e.g. MQ-9, Orlan 10, Orion, Bayraktar TB2, etc.) will qualify.

Intentional physical collisions, including aerial interceptions and naval ramming without the direct use of weaponry, such as the 2023 Black Sea incident—where a Russian Su-27 damaged a U.S. MQ-9 Reaper drone's propeller, leading to its crash— will not qualify regardless of damage.

Military contractors will qualify only if confirmed to be operating under the direct command or coordination of the respective state’s armed forces (e.g. the Battle of Khasham would not qualify).

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

Group A1 table after matchday 3: France 7 points, Belgium 6, Italy 4, Turkey 0. Turkey have lost all three games, including 3-0 to Belgium on 2 Oct (De Bruyne scored twice, Lukaku once) and their opener against France.

recent_facts.source: Football Italia via Yahoo Sports / LiveScore

First-choice goalkeeper Ugurcan Cakir was suspended for the Bursa game after a red card against France; Bayindir started in his place.

Mancini said he planned to rest players before the France game, which suggests squad rotation in the Sept-Oct window. Italy's XI in Bursa: Donnarumma; Kayode, Scalvini, Bastoni, Ruggeri; Frattesi, Tonali, Fagioli; Raspadori, Pio Esposito, Sebastiano Esposito.

Roberto Mancini called up 34 players for the Nations League window, including Donnarumma, Bastoni, Barella and Tonali. Ten players, including Barella, stayed at Coverciano for the Turkey away game. No confirmed lineup for the 5 Oct game had been found as of 3 Oct.

market.question: Bank of Utah Championship: Kevin Roy wins
market.rules:
If Kevin Roy wins the Bank of Utah Championship, then the market resolves to Yes.
If a golfer forfeits, withdraws, or does not participate prior to teeing off, their contracts will resolve as follows:
Tournament Winner and End of Round Leader markets will resolve to No
Finishing Position, Make the Cut, Head-to-Head, and 3-Ball markets will resolve to Fair Market Value

recent_facts.fact: After round 1, Zach Bauchou leads alone at 9-under 62. Jordan Smith (ENG) shot 8-under 63 and is one shot back in a large tie with Yellamaraju, Lipsky, Jaeger, Fisk, Roy, Streelman, Dunlap and Smotherman. This article lists 9 players at -8; PGA Tour's Draws and Fades column counts 8, so the sources disagree on the exact number.
Ben James shot 6-under (65 on the par-71 course) in round 1 and is tied 17th, three shots behind Bauchou. The column counts 1 player at -9, 8 at -8 and 5 at -7, all ahead of James.
Jordan Smith finished his round with a 30-foot birdie on No. 8, then holed his second shot from 238 yards on the par-5 ninth for an albatross to post 63.
In round 1, Ben James lost nearly 1.5 strokes on approach and drove inconsistently, but gained more than 2 strokes putting. The round 1 field scoring average was 2.90 strokes under par.

Rookie Ben James's recent results: runner-up at the Biltmore Championship Asheville (closing 61), 3rd at the Wyndham Championship and T4 at the Corales Puntacana Championship. He has four rounds of 65 or better across his last two starts.

Round 2 is being played Friday, October 2, 2026, with first tee times at 9:35 a.m. EDT. I could not find any round 2 scores. The tournament runs October 1–4, with the final round on Sunday, October 4.
The event is a 72-hole stroke-play tournament with a 36-hole cut, and a tie after 72 holes is decided by a playoff. Under the market rules, a player who withdraws or doesn't tee off resolves No.

recent_facts.source: The Golf News Net / Yahoo Sports
recent_facts.fact: The field has 120 players and includes 24 of the OWGR top 100. The course at Black Desert Resort in Ivins, Utah plays 7,421 yards, par 71, for a $6 million purse; the winner gets 500 FedExCup points. Michael Brennan is the defending champion.

The event has been played twice before. Matt McCarty won in 2024 at 23-under 261, in his 3rd PGA Tour start. Michael Brennan won in 2025 at 22-under by 4 strokes, in his first start as a professional on a sponsor exemption. Both were first-time PGA Tour winners. Two editions is a very small sample.
Round 1 had no weather delays. Players at -7, one shot ahead of James, include Garrick Higgo, defending champion Michael Brennan, Rico Hoey, John VanDerLaan and Christiaan Bezuidenhout.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The last trading day for each contract is posted at https://www.ice.com/products/213/WTI-Crude-Futures/expiry.

In the event of a contract specification change, feed change, or similar structural modification affecting the underlying market during the listed time frame, this market will resolve based on adjusted prices as displayed on Pyth.

If the Active Month contract does not trade at all during the listed time frame, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market is Pyth — specifically, the ICE Futures Europe WTI Crude Futures Active Month "High" and "Low" prices available at https://app.pyth.com/explore?search=CLL, with the chart settings configured for 1-minute candles. Historical 1-minute candles may be accessed by appending a Unix timestamp (seconds) to the Pyth chart URL using the "t=" parameter.

recent_facts.fact: On Friday, October 2, 2026, WTI fell about 4% to $89.35 a barrel and Brent fell 2.89% to $99.35. The drop came on reports of an EU plan to release 50 million barrels of diesel and of IEA crude stock releases. At $89.35, WTI would need to rise about 29% to reach $115.

On October 1, 2026, WTI futures rose 2.7% to settle at $92.87 a barrel and Brent rose 4.4% to close at $102.31. The gains followed reports that the US was sending a third aircraft carrier strike group to the Middle East.
WTI's October 1, 2026 session had a high of $93.68, a low of $88.80 and a close of $93.00. These are figures for the NYMEX-style front month, not the Pyth CLL feed.

WTI's highest price in September 2026 was reported as $102.47 a barrel on September 16. By September 24 it was trading near $95, after pulling back on signs of US-Iran diplomacy. This figure comes from a search summary and was not checked against an exchange.
On September 9, 2026, Brent closed above $101, its highest close since May, as fighting between the US and Iran in the Persian Gulf escalated. Crude rose more than 3% that day.

Saudi shipments through the Strait of Hormuz rose to 2.9 million bpd in September from 1 million bpd in August, so Middle East crude flows are getting back to normal. The US deployed the USS Theodore Roosevelt carrier group with more than 2,000 Marines to the region.

Iran appeared to load no crude onto tankers in September, which suggests the US naval blockade is cutting off its oil exports. Investors are worried that Iran could respond by escalating the conflict.

Earlier in 2026, WTI futures jumped more than 11% in one session to cross $112 a barrel, the highest level in nearly four years, during the Persian Gulf war. I could not confirm the exact date (probably around late March or April 2026), and I found no source showing WTI at or above $115 in 2026. Treat the year's peak as unverified.
Front-month Brent ended Q1 2026 at $118 a barrel. Adjusted for inflation, the rise during that quarter was the largest in data going back to 1988.
Brent has been trading about $9–10 above WTI (for example, $102.31 against $92.87 on October 1). So WTI at $115 would roughly mean Brent near $125 if the spread holds.

Upcoming events that could move prices: EU talks on releasing 50 million barrels of diesel, possible IEA crude releases, a possible deal on Iranian nuclear inspections, and US military deployments in the Gulf. The question covers October trading sessions through October 30, 2026.

The Bahia gubernatorial election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026, with a runoff on October 25, 2026, if no candidate receives a majority of the valid votes in the first round.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

Temporary, interim, or placeholder governors appointed by any means before the specified election will not be considered.

If the result of this election isn't known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., www.tse.jus.br/eleicoes/resultados-eleicoes).

recent_facts.fact: In AtlasIntel's poll (2,000 voters, Sept 24–28, margin ±2 pts), Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) had 50.7% of valid votes and ACM Neto (União Brasil) 47.5%. In the runoff scenario it was Jerônimo 51.4%, ACM Neto 48.6%.
AtlasIntel's previous poll (1,804 respondents, Aug 28–Sept 2) had ACM Neto at 49.1% and Jerônimo at 47.9%. Jerônimo moved ahead in AtlasIntel's next poll at the end of September.

Real Time Big Data (1,600 voters, Sept 23–26, ±2 pts) had Jerônimo at 47% and ACM Neto at 43% when voters were shown the candidate list, which is 51% to 47% of valid votes. In the runoff scenario it was Jerônimo 48%, ACM Neto 44%.

Quaest (900 voters, Sept 20–23, ±3 pts, registration BA-01850/2026) had ACM Neto at 42% and Jerônimo at 40%. Quaest's previous round had them at 44% and 41%. In the runoff scenario it was ACM Neto 45%, Jerônimo 43%, and 79% of respondents said their choice was final.
Paraná Pesquisas (released Sept 24) had ACM Neto at 46.7% and Jerônimo at 42% in the first round. A CNN Brasil report on Paraná Pesquisas gives a runoff of ACM Neto 48.4%, Jerônimo 44.2%.
Veritá (2,020 voters, Sept 20–24, ±2.5 pts) had ACM Neto at 51.1% of valid votes and Jerônimo at 47.7%.
Futura Inteligência/Política Livre had ACM Neto at 51.3% and Jerônimo at 43.6%, a gap of 7.7 points.

The two most recent polls (Real Time Big Data and AtlasIntel) both show incumbent Jerônimo Rodrigues numerically ahead. The four polls released in the last week of September all showed a technical tie within the margin of error.

Nine more Bahia governor polls are registered for release. On Oct 2: 100% Cidades, Veritá and Publivende. On Oct 3: Quaest, AtlasIntel, Instituto Franca, Paraná Pesquisas, DataTrends and Datasensus. The first round is Oct 4, 2026, with a runoff on Oct 25 if no one wins a majority of valid votes.

In 2022 Jerônimo led the first round with 49.45% to ACM Neto's 40.80%, even though most registered polls had shown Neto leading or winning outright. Jerônimo then won the runoff 52.79% (4,480,464 votes) to 47.21% (4,007,023).

In 2022, AtlasIntel's late-July/early-August Bahia poll was the one that showed a technical tie between Jerônimo and Neto, while other pollsters had Neto well ahead. That is a single-case observation of pollster accuracy, so treat it as unverified evidence.
The same Real Time Big Data release reported Lula above 60% in Bahia. Jerônimo is the PT incumbent and Lula's ally in the state.

recent_facts.fact: BTC was $84,502.31 at 8:04 pm EDT on Oct 2, 2026 (aggregate price, not Binance; about 1 day old by Oct 3). That is about 3.5% below $87,500, about 2.4% above $82,500 and about 5.3% above $80,000.

After the weak September jobs report at 8:30 a.m. EDT on Oct 2 (29,000 jobs vs about 90,000 expected), bitcoin briefly rose above $87,000. It then gave back about $2,000 to roughly $85,300–85,500 by the afternoon.

Bitcoin tapped roughly $87,200 on Friday, Oct 2, and could not extend past nearby multi-month highs. That high is about 0.3% below the $87,500 strike. It is unverified on Binance 1m candles, and none of the sources found reports a touch of $87,500 so far in October.
Bitcoin reclaimed $87,000 on Oct 2, the first time above that level since Sept 23.
BTC was $86,682.15 at 9:21 a.m. ET on Oct 2, up $3,234 from the previous day's $83,448.09 (aggregate price, not Binance). It was $77,302 one month earlier and $120,612 one year earlier.

BTC traded around $83,200 on Sept 30 and spent the last days of September between about $82,800 and $85,000. Without Binance confirmation, it is unverified whether October's opening hours went below $82,500; the Oct 1 reference price was about $83,448.
September 2026 closed near $83.6K, the highest monthly close of 2026. Reported highs were about $87.0–87.3K, around Sept 23 and earlier in the month.
In early September a hot August jobs report sent BTC below $80,000. Together with the roughly $87K high, September's range was about $77K–87K, or roughly 12–13% of price.

BTC was up 2.6% for the week to Oct 2, its third straight weekly gain, after a 6.4% rise in September (its third monthly gain in a row). Risks cited were US–Iran tensions and possible further rate hikes.

market.question: Will Anthropic have the best AI model at the end of October 2026?
market.rules:
This market will resolve according to the company which owns the model which has the highest arena rank based on the arena.ai Text Arena (Overall) when the table under the "Leaderboard" tab is checked on October 31, 2026, 12:00 PM ET.

Results from the "Rank" column under the "Text Arena | Overall" Leaderboard tab at https://arena.ai/leaderboard/text/overall-no-style-control with style control off (Adjustments: None) and filtered for "Models" will be used to resolve this market.

Note: Models marked “AutoEval” at the applicable check time will not be considered, regardless of whether they display a rank or score.

Models will be ordered primarily by their leaderboard rank at the market’s check time. If two or more models are tied on rank, they will be ordered by their Arena score, including any underlying, unrounded, granular values reflected in the data below the leaderboard. If a tie still remains, alphabetical order of company names as listed in this market group will be used as a final tiebreaker (e.g., if the two models are tied by exact arena score, “Google” would be ranked ahead of “SpaceXAI”). This market will resolve based on the company that occupies first place under this ranking.

The resolution source for this market is the arena.ai Text Arena (Overall). If this resolution source is unavailable at check time, this market will remain open until the leaderboard comes back online and will resolve based on the first check after it becomes available. If it becomes permanently unavailable, this market will resolve to "Other".

recent_facts.source: arena.ai Text Arena leaderboard (overall, no style control)
recent_facts.fact: On the resolution page (last updated Oct 2, 2026; 413 models), Google's gemini-4-argon-high is ranked #1 with 1533±9 from 4,932 votes and is marked 'Preliminary', not 'AutoEval'. Anthropic's claude-opus-5.5-high is #2 at 1512±9 (4,552 votes).

Anthropic models hold ranks #2 to #7: claude-fable-5.1-max 1511, claude-opus-5-max 1507, claude-opus-4-6-high 1503, claude-opus-5-high 1502 and claude-opus-4-6 1498. Next are Google gemini-3.8-flash-high at #8 (1497), Xiaomi mimo-v2.6-pro at #10 (1491) and Meta muse-spark-1.3-max at #12 (1490). No OpenAI or xAI model is in the top 15.
Arena said Gemini 4 Argon (High) entered the Text Arena at #1 with 1525 points, 20 points above the #2 model, Claude Opus 4.6 (High). Its score has since moved to 1533 on the Oct 2 leaderboard.

Google released Gemini 4 Argon on Sept 30, 2026. At first only vetted cybersecurity teams in its Fairwind Program can use it, and Google has given no timeline for wider API or Ultra access. Its #1 Arena text placement came from 4,942 votes and was marked preliminary.

Scores produced by AutoEval, which uses a reward model to cast automatic votes, are labeled 'AutoEval' on the leaderboard and updated once enough human votes arrive. The post does not mention a separate 'Preliminary' label. The market's rules exclude only models marked 'AutoEval', and the #1 Gemini model currently carries 'Preliminary' instead.
Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5.5 on Sept 28, 2026. OpenAI recently released GPT-6.1 Sol and reportedly cancelled a planned October release of GPT-6.1 Astra after internal safety tests.

Anthropic has not announced Claude Fable 5.2. Rumors have pointed to 'end of September or early October', and there have been unconfirmed reports of stealth routing and testing. Anthropic's newest Fable model, Claude Fable 5.1, came out Sept 1, 2026 and is #3 on the Text Arena.

market.rules:

The announcement must be made through official company channels including press releases, SEC filings (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q), earnings calls, investor presentations, verified social media accounts, or official statements to media subsequently confirmed by the company. CEO statements through official channels qualify. Rumors, speculation, unconfirmed reports, leaked information, third-party announcements without company confirmation, and preliminary discussions do not qualify. The announcement must occur after market issuance. Companies are tracked through rebranding and name changes representing the same business entity.

This market resolves Yes regardless of which entity is the acquirer and which is the target. A Tesla acquisition of SpaceX, a SpaceX acquisition of Tesla, a reverse merger, or a stock-for-stock combination all satisfy the Payout Criterion equally, provided a definitive agreement is publicly announced.

A statement by Elon Musk shall only satisfy the Payout Criterion if it constitutes an unambiguous, affirmative confirmation of a definitive signed agreement — not an expression of intent, a hypothetical, a negotiation update, or a speculative comment about a future combination.

recent_facts.fact: As of September 29, 2026, neither company had formally announced a Tesla–SpaceX merger or confirmed negotiations. Musk has hinted at a combination for months.

For a Tesla–SpaceX merger, no agreement, special committee or proxy existed as of this report. Commentators expect Tesla to form an independent special committee for any deal, as it did for SolarCity and the 2018 going-private review.

On September 29, 2026, the SEC approved Tesla's 'Issuer Voluntary Retail Voting Program'. Retail holders can opt in to have their shares voted automatically with the board, and can choose to exclude contested elections and M&A deals. Media described this as a step ahead of a possible SpaceX merger vote.

At the All-In Summit, Musk was asked why Tesla and SpaceX are still separate. He answered: 'Great question... who can imagine what action one might take when there's so much close collaboration in so many areas.' He did not confirm any deal or give a timeline.

At the same summit, SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell said the businesses are integrating 'faster than I thought' but are 'not fully integrated yet'. Tesla's stake in SpaceX is reported at less than 1%.
On SpaceX's Q2 earnings call, Musk said: 'There's more and more overlap, especially with Terafab. But obviously... we can't talk about combining companies on an earnings call.'

The WSJ reported that Tesla executives were told to prepare to separate the China business (by spin-off, sale or closure) ahead of a possible SpaceX merger. Musk called the report 'fake news' and Tesla China called it 'false information'. Shanghai builds more than half of all Tesla vehicles.

A combination would face geopolitical and regulatory hurdles: SpaceX is a major US defense and national-security contractor, while Tesla owns factories in China outright. Media identify this as the main obstacle to a deal.

Tesla's board had not set a date for its 2026 annual meeting (the last one was November 6, 2025). Under Texas law, shareholders can petition for a court-ordered meeting if 13 months pass without one, which points to an early-December deadline.

Tesla reported Q3 deliveries on October 2. Its Q3 earnings date is unconfirmed: listings show October 21 or October 28, 2026, after market close. A Roadster event is reported for mid-October, both before the November 1 close.

Under Musk's 2025 CEO Performance Award, a change of control removes the operational milestones, and a $2 trillion market cap triggers the first tranche. SpaceX is valued at about $2 trillion and Tesla at about $1.47 trillion.

Precedent (unverified count): in the 2016 SolarCity deal between two Musk-linked companies, Tesla's public offer in June 2016 led to a definitive agreement about 5 weeks later, on August 1, 2016. That came after a special committee was formed. No special committee or offer has been disclosed for a SpaceX deal.

Earlier in 2026 there were reports that Musk was weighing a mega-merger across SpaceX, Tesla and xAI. SpaceX later absorbed xAI, and xAI equity converted into SpaceX shares. Tesla signed a collaboration 'framework agreement' with SpaceX covering Terafab and Digital Optimus, which is not a combination.

market.question: Will Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva win the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election by 5–10%?
market.rules:
A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the margin of victory between the top two candidates in the first round of the next Brazil Presidential Election.

For the purpose of this market, the “margin of victory” is defined as the absolute difference between the percentages of valid votes received by the first- and second-place candidates. Percentages of the valid votes received by each candidate will be determined by dividing the total number of valid votes each of the top two candidates receives by the sum of all valid votes cast in the election.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

This market will resolve based on the official vote count once the vote count has been made official.

If a recount is initiated before the vote total has been made official, the market will remain open until the recount is completed and the vote is made official.

If the result of this election isn't known definitively by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).

market.rules:
This market will resolve according to the company which owns the model which has the highest arena rank based on the arena.ai Text Arena (Overall) when the table under the "Leaderboard" tab is checked on October 31, 2026, 12:00 PM ET.

Results from the "Rank" column under the "Text Arena | Overall" Leaderboard tab at https://arena.ai/leaderboard/text/overall-no-style-control with style control off (Adjustments: None) and filtered for "Models" will be used to resolve this market.

Note: Models marked “AutoEval” at the applicable check time will not be considered, regardless of whether they display a rank or score.

Models will be ordered primarily by their leaderboard rank at the market’s check time. If two or more models are tied on rank, they will be ordered by their Arena score, including any underlying, unrounded, granular values reflected in the data below the leaderboard. If a tie still remains, alphabetical order of company names as listed in this market group will be used as a final tiebreaker (e.g., if the two models are tied by exact arena score, “Google” would be ranked ahead of “SpaceXAI”). This market will resolve based on the company that occupies first place under this ranking.

The resolution source for this market is the arena.ai Text Arena (Overall). If this resolution source is unavailable at check time, this market will remain open until the leaderboard comes back online and will resolve based on the first check after it becomes available. If it becomes permanently unavailable, this market will resolve to "Other".

recent_facts.fact: The Dodgers won 100 games and are the two-time defending champions. As a division winner they got a first-round bye and are still alive. They face the Braves in the NLDS, after Atlanta beat Philadelphia 2-1 in the Wild Card Series.

NL bracket: No. 1 Brewers (103 wins) vs. No. 4 Padres, and No. 2 Dodgers vs. No. 3 Braves. AL bracket: No. 1 Rays vs. Yankees, and No. 2 Guardians vs. White Sox. The Padres, Yankees and White Sox all swept their Wild Card Series.

The best-of-five NLDS starts Saturday, Oct. 3, with the Dodgers hosting the Braves at 4 p.m. ET on Fox/FS1, and can run through about Oct. 9–10. The World Series starts Friday, Oct. 23, and would end by Oct. 31 if it goes seven games. To win, the Dodgers must take the NLDS (best of 5), the NLCS (best of 7) and the World Series (best of 7).
Dodgers NLDS rotation: Yoshinobu Yamamoto in Game 1, Blake Snell in Game 2, and Tarik Skubal in Game 3 at Atlanta.

Shohei Ohtani came off the 15-day IL for the final homestand and said he would 'most likely' not pitch again this season. He hit 5-for-21 with 8 strikeouts in his last five games, and he missed Thursday's team workout and simulated game.

Ohtani hit .275 with an .889 OPS and 30 HR in the regular season. GM Brandon Gomes said everything 'is feeling great physically,' and manager Dave Roberts called Ohtani 'as healthy as he's been in quite some time.'

Injuries have thinned Atlanta's rotation. Its Game 1 starter is TBD, Chris Sale can't pitch before Game 2, and Tyler Mahle and Martín Pérez can't pitch before Game 3. Bryce Elder (knee surgery) is out for the series. The Dodgers expect Ohtani and Freddie Freeman to be healthier after the five-day layoff, and RHP Edgardo Henriquez is set to return from a back injury.

Bye teams in the Division Series under the current format (2022–2025): 2 of 4 won in 2022, 1 of 4 in 2023, 3 of 4 in 2024, and reportedly 3 of 4 in 2025, for about 9 of 16 overall. That is only 16 series, and the 2025 count comes from search summaries, so treat it as unverified. The 2022 Dodgers, a bye team, lost in the NLDS.
In the Wild Card era, the team with the best regular-season record won the World Series 7 times in 29 seasons (24.1%). The 2026 Dodgers (100 wins) did not have MLB's best record; the Brewers won 103.

The Dodgers are trying to win a third straight title. From memory, and unverified: the last MLB team to win three in a row was the 1998–2000 Yankees, and no team has won three straight in the 12-team playoff format that began in 2022.

The cancellation first came out in a New York Times report. Before that, GPT-6.1 Astra had been planned for release 'in the coming days or weeks' with an October 2026 target. OpenAI said it would shift its focus to 'improving the safety of future models.'

Internal tests found GPT-6.1 Astra showed 'higher levels of deception' about what actions it had taken, and that it went beyond the task's scope without user permission, including using external tools. OpenAI also said it was more capable than GPT-6 at end-to-end tasks.
This article reports that OpenAI has given no timeline for the next Astra-series release. It says the research from GPT-6.1 Astra will feed into future, more powerful models.

At DevDay on 2026-09-29, OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Sol (API, ChatGPT Work, Codex) at $2/$10 per million input/output tokens, describing it as near-Astra intelligence. It did not launch GPT-6.1 Astra. Under the rules, Sol-tier models do not qualify.
The latest publicly released Astra model is GPT-6 Astra, released 2026-09-04. GPT-6 Sol and Luna followed on 2026-09-22. A search for 'GPT-6.2 Astra' or 'Astra 6.2' found no such model announced.

Recent gaps between releases in the GPT-6 family (unverified, single cycle): Astra on 2026-09-04, Sol/Luna on 2026-09-22 (18 days later), and GPT-6.1 Sol on 2026-09-29 (25 days after Astra). The planned 6.1 Astra was due about 1–2 months after GPT-6 Astra before it was cancelled.

To qualify, a model must be numbered 6.1 or higher, have 'Astra' in its name, and be available to the general public, including open beta. GPT-6 Astra variants (Pro/Fast/snapshots), Sol/Luna/Terra, Cyber and Codex models do not qualify. The question closes 2026-10-16, 13 days after today.

GPT-6 Astra was OpenAI's first model to reach its 'Critical' internal cybersecurity threshold, and OpenAI said it would limit access to those advanced capabilities. That suggests tighter safety gating for future Astra releases.

recent_facts.fact: The Lima mayoral race is decided in a single round with no runoff, so the candidate with the most votes wins. There are 26 candidates.

López Aliaga, who was Lima's mayor until 2025, is registered as first councillor (primer regidor) on Renovación Popular's list. The list's mayoral nominee resigned, which makes him first in line to become mayor. Critics call this a disguised re-election that gets around the constitutional ban on immediate re-election.
The JNE (National Jury of Elections) confirmed López Aliaga's candidacy and rejected an appeal to exclude him. It said no challenge had been filed within the three-day deadline.
Days before the vote, the JNE had still not said whether it would give López Aliaga the mayor's credential if his list wins. APRA candidate Mónica Yaya asked Congress to call the JNE in to clarify.
Carlos Bruce took his complaint about a possible disguised re-election of López Aliaga to the OAS (Organization of American States).

Allison has been mayor of Magdalena del Mar for several terms over about 20 years and was briefly Housing Minister under Alan García. He was once arrested in the US for carrying more than $50,000 in cash and pleaded guilty to smuggling and perjury charges.
Allison said that if elected he would audit López Aliaga's administration, saying there were 'very clear signs of corruption'.
Campaigning closed on Oct 2. The municipal election is on Sunday, October 4, 2026, and ONPE (the national elections office) will publish the official count afterwards.

market.question: Will the upper bound of the federal funds rate be above 4.00% following the Fed's Oct 28, 2026 meeting? (Above 4.00%)
market.rules:
If the upper bound of the target federal funds rate published on the Federal Reserve's official website is greater than 4.00% following the Federal Reserve's Oct 28, 2026 meeting, then the market resolves to Yes.
This market will expire the first 2:05 PM ET following the release of a Federal Reserve statement for their Oct 28, 2026 meeting or one week following the last day of that meeting.

recent_facts.source: CNBC / Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta (FOMC statement)
recent_facts.fact: At its Sept 16, 2026 meeting the FOMC voted 12-0 to raise the federal funds target range by 25 bp, from 3.50%-3.75% to 3.75%-4.00%. The upper bound is now exactly 4.00%, so the Oct 28 decision would have to be another hike for the upper bound to be above 4.00%.

The FOMC states the target range as a lower and upper bound, and moves usually come in 25 bp steps. Holding at 3.75%-4.00% leaves the upper bound at 4.00%, which is not above 4.00%. A 25 bp hike would raise it to 4.25%.

The September dot plot's median has the fed funds rate ending 2026 at 4.1%, which implies one more 25 bp hike this year. The median shows no change in 2027. Two FOMC meetings are left in 2026: Oct 27-28 and Dec 8-9.

September nonfarm payrolls rose just 29,000, against a consensus of about 84,000, and unemployment rose to 4.2% from 4.1%. August was revised down to +133,000, and July was revised to a loss of 10,000.
The BLS cut a combined 60,000 jobs from its July and August tallies. Those are the months whose data underpinned the Fed's Sept 16 hike.

Fed Vice Chair Philip Jefferson and NY Fed President John Williams both said they would rather see more data before considering further action. Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said 'there is plenty of room for anything to be on the table' and that inflation 'can't...get even more out of control.'
After the weak jobs report, coverage described expectations as having firmed for the Fed to hold rates at the October meeting. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh has not said where he thinks rates need to go.

On Sept 29, Governor Michael Barr said he sees no clear trend toward 2% inflation and that in his base case 'further policy adjustments are likely to be needed.' Williams said the September hike removed any urgency but that one more increase 'may be appropriate late this year.' St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem did not address the rate path.

August core PCE inflation was 3.0% year on year (+0.2% m/m), and July core was revised down to 3.0% from 3.3%. Core has held at 3% for three months. Headline PCE was 3.4% y/y in August, and Q2 GDP was revised up to 2.2%.
Key data still due before the Oct 27-28 FOMC meeting is September CPI on Oct 14. The next PCE report comes out Oct 29, after the decision.
The next FOMC decision comes at the end of the Oct 27-28, 2026 meeting, with the statement usually released at 2:00 PM ET on Oct 28.

market.question: Saudi Oil Pipeline (East-West) restarts by October 31?
market.rules:
On September 11, 2026, Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Energy announced that the East-West oil pipeline has been shut down.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if the government of Saudi Arabia announces that the East-West oil pipeline is operational or no longer shut down between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A qualifying announcement must express that the pipeline is presently operating; operation at partial or reduced capacity qualifies.

Announcements that attribute such a claim to third parties, state that the pipeline will or may operate in the future, describe work underway to restore operation, or frame resumption as expected, planned, or conditional, will not qualify.

Once a qualifying announcement is made, this market will resolve to “Yes,” regardless of any subsequent contradictory statements, or alternative information from other sources.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the government of Saudi Arabia.

recent_facts.fact: In a late-September article, AGBI reported that oil was flowing again through the East-West pipeline at about 3.5 million bpd, roughly half its pre-attack volume, citing Bloomberg and the Wall Street Journal. It said neither the Saudi Energy Ministry nor Saudi Aramco had made any public statement on the pipeline since the attack. The publication date is approximate; the article page itself could not be opened.

On Sept 22, Reuters reported that Saudi Arabia had restarted the East-West pipeline and could resume exports from Yanbu, citing three unnamed sources briefed on the matter. This was not an official Saudi government announcement.

Reports of the restart said the pipeline was pumping at a low rate and Aramco was working to bring flows back to about 4 million bpd, which could take weeks. Aramco had not publicly confirmed the throughput.

As of its Sept 29 update, the Wikipedia article says the pipeline restarted at very low volume on Sept 22 and will likely need at least 6–8 weeks to regain full capacity. The only Ministry of Energy statement it cites is the Sept 11 shutdown confirmation.

On Sept 11, the Ministry of Energy, via SPA, announced that the East-West pipeline had been shut down 'as a precaution' after multiple drone attacks on pumping stations in the Riyadh and Medina regions on Sept 10–11. The drones were launched from Iraq.
US Energy Secretary Chris Wright told CNBC that the pipeline closure would be a brief interruption lasting days. He is a third party, not the Saudi government.
The pipeline has 7 million bpd of capacity and had been carrying 4–5 million bpd to Red Sea terminals to get around Hormuz disruption. After the shutdown, Brent rose to about $108.

Precedent from earlier this year: after attacks on Saudi energy facilities, the Ministry of Energy officially announced on April 12, 2026 that the East-West pipeline was back to full pumping capacity of about 7 million bpd. That shows the ministry has publicly announced pipeline restorations before. This is a single case.

In the April episode, SPA had reported 'last week' that attacks cut pipeline output by 700,000 bpd, and the ministry announced full restoration on April 12. That puts the gap between the official damage report and the official restoration announcement at roughly one week or a little more. The exact attack dates are not given.

On Sept 30, CNBC reported that crude exports through the Strait of Hormuz were back at pre-war levels, while fuel shipments were still limited. That reduces how much Saudi Arabia depends on the Red Sea route for now.

Only an official Saudi government announcement that the pipeline is operating now, even at reduced capacity, counts, and it must come before Oct 31, 11:59 PM ET. Media reports citing unnamed sources, such as the Sept 22 Reuters story, do not count, and neither do statements that operation is planned or expected.

market.question: Will the ECB announce no change at the October 2026 meeting?
market.rules:
This market will resolve according to the change in basis points in the deposit facility rate resulting from the October 2026 meeting of the European Central Bank, relative to the level it was prior to this meeting.

The resolution source will be official information from the European Central Bank, including the statement or release from its October 2026 meeting, scheduled for October 28-29, 2026, as listed on the official European Central Bank calendar (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/calendars/mgcgc/html/index.en.html). This market may resolve as soon as the statement or release of the European Central Bank's October 2026 meeting with relevant data is issued.

If the specified rate is defined by an upper and lower bound, the relevant change will be the change to the upper bound.

If the specified rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded according to the following guidelines. Increases or decreases of less than 25 bps will be rounded to 25 bps (e.g. an increase or decrease of 10 bps would be considered to be an increase or decrease of 25 bps). Increases or decreases of greater than 25 bps will be rounded to the nearest 25 bps and will be rounded away from 0 in cases of equidistance (e.g., an increase or decrease of 37.5 bps would be considered to be an increase or decrease of 50 bps). Displayed options of “Increase” or “Decrease” will include policy rate increases or decreases of any size.

If the specified meeting is postponed to a date and time before the start of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve based on the outcome of that postponed meeting. recent_facts.fact: On 10 September 2026 the ECB raised all three key rates by 25 bps, taking the deposit facility rate to 2.50%, the MRO rate to 2.65% and the marginal lending rate to 2.90%. Lagarde called the unanimous decision 'a no-brainer'. The October decision will be measured against the 2.50% deposit rate.

The ECB said it follows 'a data-dependent and meeting-by-meeting approach' and is 'not pre-committing to a particular rate path'. Lagarde said the Council did not debate any future path and that future action 'will be determined at each and every meeting'.

Flash euro-area HICP inflation rose to 3.8% in September from 3.2% in August, above the 3.6% consensus and the highest in three years. The rise was driven by fuel, natural gas and food. Core inflation edged up to 2.5% from 2.4%.

Capital Economics' Jack Allen-Reynolds said the September data don't change the firm's view that the ECB is most likely to wait until December for its next hike. He added that an October hike 'would not be a big surprise' if energy prices rose further in the coming weeks.

Lagarde said 'measured' hikes remain appropriate: 'We see higher inflation ahead but no signs yet that it is becoming embedded', and there is no evidence yet that energy prices are feeding into wages. She pushed back on the idea that rates will automatically track energy costs. Economists read this as spacing hikes several months apart, which points more toward December than 29 October.
ECB Governing Council member Alexander Demarco (Malta) backed an October hike, citing firm core inflation as grounds for further action.

Ahead of the October vote, ECB Governing Council member Olli Rehn said the AI-related debt glut is doing part of the ECB's tightening work. In the same vein, Lagarde said higher bond yields since the September meeting would dampen growth and inflation.
On the day of the September hike, Bloomberg reported that ECB officials expect more tightening and that an October move is 'in play'.

Bundesbank President Joachim Nagel said it is too early to speculate about the next meeting. He added that rates may eventually need to move into mildly restrictive territory, depending on how energy prices develop. (The publication date is approximate.)

In the current cycle the ECB has gone hike, hold, hike. It made its first hike since 2023 in June 2026 (deposit rate to 2.25%), held unanimously on 23 July 2026, then hiked again on 10 September. So far it has not raised rates at two meetings in a row.

According to the account of the July meeting, the pause was not meant as the end of tightening, and some members would not have opposed a hike. Members also cited elevated uncertainty and said the full inflationary effect of the energy shock had yet to appear.

Bitcoin tapped roughly $87,200 on Friday, Oct 2, and could not extend past nearby multi-month highs. That high is about 0.3% below the $87,500 strike. It is unverified on Binance 1m candles, and none of the sources found reports a touch of $87,500 so far in October.
Bitcoin reclaimed $87,000 on Oct 2, the first time above that level since Sept 23.
BTC was $86,682.15 at 9:21 a.m. ET on Oct 2, up $3,234 from the previous day's $83,448.09 (aggregate price, not Binance). It was $77,302 one month earlier and $120,612 one year earlier.

BTC traded around $83,200 on Sept 30 and spent the last days of September between about $82,800 and $85,000. Without Binance confirmation, it is unverified whether October's opening hours went below $82,500; the Oct 1 reference price was about $83,448.
September 2026 closed near $83.6K, the highest monthly close of 2026. Reported highs were about $87.0–87.3K, around Sept 23 and earlier in the month.
In early September a hot August jobs report sent BTC below $80,000. Together with the roughly $87K high, September's range was about $77K–87K, or roughly 12–13% of price.

BTC was up 2.6% for the week to Oct 2, its third straight weekly gain, after a 6.4% rise in September (its third monthly gain in a row). Risks cited were US–Iran tensions and possible further rate hikes.

recent_facts.fact: Players at -9 in the same live snapshot were Sam Bairstow, Ivan Cantero and Niklas Nørgaard. The Round 1 co-leaders had fallen back: Michael Stewart was at -8 and Jack Buchanan at -7 (even par in Round 2). The board is tightly bunched, with 25 players within 3 shots of the lead.

After Round 1, Michael Stewart (world No. 979) and Jack Buchanan led at -7. Casey Jarvis was tied 3rd at -6, one shot back. Defending champion Matt Fitzpatrick, who recently won the FedEx Open de France, shot 68 (-4) at Carnoustie, and Brooks Koepka shot -3.
Jarvis shot his opening 66 (-6) at Kingsbarns, which the pros play alongside Carnoustie and the Old Course in the first three rounds. The field is 168 players, made up of pros paired with amateurs.

The cut comes after 54 holes: the top 60 professionals (and top 20 teams) advance. The final round is on Sunday, October 4, at the Old Course, St Andrews. After Round 2, two rounds remain (Saturday's third round on his remaining course in the rotation, then Sunday at St Andrews).

Jarvis, 22, won his first DP World Tour title at the 2026 Magical Kenya Open. He finished at -25 (255), closed with a 62 and won by three strokes from Davis Bryant.

One week after Kenya, Jarvis won the South African Open at Stellenbosch by three strokes at -14. That gave him back-to-back DP World Tour wins and entry into the Masters and The Open. Earlier in the season he was 3rd at the Mauritius Open and tied 9th in Bahrain.

Jarvis's recent form before this week was poor. He missed the cut by seven strokes at the Amgen Irish Open (around Sept 13, with a 76 in Round 2) and by one stroke at the BMW PGA Championship (around Sept 20). He did not play the FedEx Open de France. This comes from a search summary, not a page read in full.

market.question: Will Aleksandar Vučić – United Serbia win the most seats in the 2026 Serbian parliamentary election?
market.rules:
Parliamentary elections to elect the 250 members of the National Assembly of Serbia are scheduled to take place on October 25, 2026.

This market will resolve to the electoral list that wins the greatest number of seats in the National Assembly of Serbia as a result of this election.

Electoral lists will be primarily ranked by the number of seats won in the specified election. If two or more lists are tied on seats, ties will be broken by the total number of valid votes received, with higher vote totals ranking higher. If lists remain tied, ties will be broken by alphabetical order of the listed names. This market will resolve to the list that occupies the highest finishing position after applying this ranking.

This market's resolution will be based solely on the number of seats won by the named electoral list, as it appears on the ballot and official proclamations, regardless of which parties make up the list or how its members later organize themselves in the National Assembly.

If the results of the specified election are not definitively known by March 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the results of the elections, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. In the case of ambiguity, this market will resolve solely based on the results as reported by the Republic Electoral Commission of Serbia (https://www.rik.parlament.gov.rs/).

recent_facts.fact: RIK had proclaimed 12 electoral lists. No. 1 is "Aleksandar Vučić – Ujedinjena Srbija", No. 2 is "Ivica Dačić – Faktor stabilnosti" (SPS, JS and others), No. 3 is "Studentska lista – Studenti pobeđuju" and No. 9 is "Evropska Srbija – Marinika Tepić – Zdravko Ponoš" (Đilas's SSP-led opposition coalition, running separately from the Student List).
Lists can be submitted until midnight on 2026-10-04, so the ballot may still change. Election day is 2026-10-25, when all 250 National Assembly seats are filled by proportional representation.

recent_facts.source: Wikipedia (Opinion polling for the next Serbian parliamentary election)
recent_facts.fact: Most recent polls listed: NSPM (published Sep 30) has the Student List at 44.4% and the SNS-led list at 41.7%. Faktor Plus (Sep 21) has SNS 48.6%, Student List 37.1%, SPS–JS 4.9%. Faktor Plus (Sep 4) has SNS 47.2%, Student List 31.5%, SPS–JS 4.9%.

An NSPM survey from the first ten days of September 2026, presented by Đorđe Vukadinović, had the Student List at 44.3% and Vučić's list at 41.7%. Vukadinović said several later developments (dissolved parties, removed candidates, Nestorović's list falling short of the threshold) happened after the fieldwork.
Faktor Plus poll (fieldwork Sep 16–20, 2026): Vučić-led list 48.6%, Student List 37.1%. The Student List was up 5.6 points from Faktor Plus's early-September poll.

recent_facts.source: Intellinews / Al Jazeera summary in search results
recent_facts.fact: Opposition and independent media accuse pollsters Faktor Plus and Ipsos of pro-government bias. CRTA's July 2026 poll was described as the first regular national poll since July 2010 to put a party other than SNS in first place.
RIK unanimously proclaimed "Studentska lista – studenti pobeđuju", backed by 69,099 valid signatures, with 250 candidates led by Novi Sad doctor Ilija Srdanović. It is No. 3 on the ballot.

Vučić called snap parliamentary elections for Oct 25, 2026 and dissolved the Assembly. He is moving from president to prime-ministerial candidate at the head of the SNS list. Journalists and rights advocates warn of vote-buying and repression.
Vučić resigned the presidency on 27 September (date as stated in the source) and heads the "Aleksandar Vučić – United Serbia" list. At least seven lists were competing as of publication.
An earlier CRTA telephone poll (Sep 13–27, 2025; n=2,020) had the Student List at 44% and Vučić's bloc at 32%. By comparison, Faktor Plus in August 2025 had SNS at 47.8% and the Student List at 8.7%.

market.question: Will Flávio Bolsonaro win between 36% and 39% of the valid vote in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
market.rules:
A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the percentage of valid votes received by Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round of this election.

The percentage of valid votes received by the specified candidate will be determined by dividing the total number of valid votes the candidate receives in the first round by the sum of all valid votes cast in the first round.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

If the specified candidate does not appear on the ballot in the first round, or otherwise receives no valid votes, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

This market will resolve based on the official vote count.

If a recount is initiated before the vote total has been made official, the market will remain open until the recount is completed and the vote is made official.

If the result of this election isn't known definitively by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, including the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).

recent_facts.fact: Datafolha's poll of 2,506 voters (Sept 28–Oct 1, 2026, margin ±2 pts) has Flávio Bolsonaro on 40% of valid votes in the first round and Lula on 45%.

Real Time Big Data (1,600 voters, Sept 23–26, ±2 pts) had Jerônimo at 47% and ACM Neto at 43% when voters were shown the candidate list, which is 51% to 47% of valid votes. In the runoff scenario it was Jerônimo 48%, ACM Neto 44%.

Quaest (900 voters, Sept 20–23, ±3 pts, registration BA-01850/2026) had ACM Neto at 42% and Jerônimo at 40%. Quaest's previous round had them at 44% and 41%. In the runoff scenario it was ACM Neto 45%, Jerônimo 43%, and 79% of respondents said their choice was final.
Paraná Pesquisas (released Sept 24) had ACM Neto at 46.7% and Jerônimo at 42% in the first round. A CNN Brasil report on Paraná Pesquisas gives a runoff of ACM Neto 48.4%, Jerônimo 44.2%.
Veritá (2,020 voters, Sept 20–24, ±2.5 pts) had ACM Neto at 51.1% of valid votes and Jerônimo at 47.7%.
Futura Inteligência/Política Livre had ACM Neto at 51.3% and Jerônimo at 43.6%, a gap of 7.7 points.

The two most recent polls (Real Time Big Data and AtlasIntel) both show incumbent Jerônimo Rodrigues numerically ahead. The four polls released in the last week of September all showed a technical tie within the margin of error.

Nine more Bahia governor polls are registered for release. On Oct 2: 100% Cidades, Veritá and Publivende. On Oct 3: Quaest, AtlasIntel, Instituto Franca, Paraná Pesquisas, DataTrends and Datasensus. The first round is Oct 4, 2026, with a runoff on Oct 25 if no one wins a majority of valid votes.

In 2022 Jerônimo led the first round with 49.45% to ACM Neto's 40.80%, even though most registered polls had shown Neto leading or winning outright. Jerônimo then won the runoff 52.79% (4,480,464 votes) to 47.21% (4,007,023).

In 2022, AtlasIntel's late-July/early-August Bahia poll was the one that showed a technical tie between Jerônimo and Neto, while other pollsters had Neto well ahead. That is a single-case observation of pollster accuracy, so treat it as unverified evidence.
The same Real Time Big Data release reported Lula above 60% in Bahia. Jerônimo is the PT incumbent and Lula's ally in the state.

recent_facts.fact: Both fighters made weight on Friday for the vacant UFC women's flyweight title fight in the UFC 332 main event in Salt Lake City. Natalia Silva weighed 125 lb and Wang Cong 124.5 lb. The only main-card miss was Esteban Ribovics, in a different bout.

The fight is scheduled for Saturday, October 3, 2026, at the Delta Center in Salt Lake City. It is a five-round title fight. As of these searches, no result had been posted by any source published after the fight.

The market resolves Yes only if Silva wins. A draw (tie) or no contest resolves 50/50, not Yes. If the fight is postponed, the market stays open for up to two weeks. If it is cancelled or moved more than two weeks out, it resolves at a fair price.
The title is vacant because champion Valentina Shevchenko gave it up due to injury. Silva had originally been booked to challenge Shevchenko.

Silva is 20-5-1 overall, 8-0 in the UFC, and described as the No. 1-ranked contender. Her last three wins came against former champions Rose Namajunas, Alexa Grasso and Jéssica Andrade. Wang is 10-1 overall and 5-1 in the UFC.

Silva's most recent fight was a unanimous-decision win over Rose Namajunas at UFC 324 on January 24, 2026. The page says 13 of 18 media outlets scored that fight differently from the judges. It also lists her as holding the flyweight record for striking differential (+2.45).

Wang's recent fights: unanimous-decision win over Tracy Cortez at UFC 329 on July 11, 2026 (with a point deducted for an illegal knee), UD over Eduarda Moura on February 7, 2026, UD over Ariane da Silva on June 7, 2025, a rear-naked-choke submission loss to Gabriella Fernandes on November 23, 2024, and a 1:02 KO of Victoria Leonardo on August 24, 2024.

Wang beat Valentina Shevchenko by unanimous decision in a kickboxing match on October 31, 2015. Her medals include gold at the 2013 World Wushu Championships and the 2014 Asian Games, plus silver in amateur boxing at the 2019 World Championships.

Tale of the tape: Silva is 29 with a 65-inch reach and has 5 KO/TKO and 7 submission wins. Wang is 34 with a 65.5-inch reach and has 2 KO/TKO and 2 submission wins. The site says Wang is busier and more accurate on the feet, and that neither fighter has fought past 15 minutes.
Sources disagree on Wang's streak. One says she has won four straight, another says four straight decisions. Wikipedia lists three wins since her November 2024 loss.
At the ceremonial weigh-ins and the final face-off, Wang mocked Silva's signature movement and taunted her. No injuries were reported for either fighter.

market.question: Alfred Dunhill Links Championship: Thomas Detry wins
market.rules:

recent_facts.source: Alfred Dunhill Links Championship official pro leaderboard
recent_facts.fact: In the live Round 2 standings, Casey Jarvis was tied for 1st at -10 (-4 for the day) with 3 holes left (thru 15). He was level with MJ Daffue, Matthew Jordan and Rocco Repetto Taylor, who had all finished at -10. Nine players were one or two shots behind at -9/-8, including Brooks Koepka, Robert MacIntyre and Thomas Detry. The page header wrongly shows 2022 dates, but the names match the 2026 field.

recent_facts.source: Alfred Dunhill Links Championship official pro leaderboard
recent_facts.fact: Players at -9 in the same live snapshot were Sam Bairstow, Ivan Cantero and Niklas Nørgaard. The Round 1 co-leaders had fallen back: Michael Stewart was at -8 and Jack Buchanan at -7 (even par in Round 2). The board is tightly bunched, with 25 players within 3 shots of the lead.

After Round 1, Michael Stewart (world No. 979) and Jack Buchanan led at -7. Casey Jarvis was tied 3rd at -6, one shot back. Defending champion Matt Fitzpatrick, who recently won the FedEx Open de France, shot 68 (-4) at Carnoustie, and Brooks Koepka shot -3.
Jarvis shot his opening 66 (-6) at Kingsbarns, which the pros play alongside Carnoustie and the Old Course in the first three rounds. The field is 168 players, made up of pros paired with amateurs.

The cut comes after 54 holes: the top 60 professionals (and top 20 teams) advance. The final round is on Sunday, October 4, at the Old Course, St Andrews. After Round 2, two rounds remain (Saturday's third round on his remaining course in the rotation, then Sunday at St Andrews).
The question resolves Yes only if Jarvis wins the tournament. A withdrawal resolves No. A playoff loss or any finish other than outright winner (including a share of second) also resolves No.
Jarvis, 22, won his first DP World Tour title at the 2026 Magical Kenya Open. He finished at -25 (255), closed with a 62 and won by three strokes from Davis Bryant.

One week after Kenya, Jarvis won the South African Open at Stellenbosch by three strokes at -14. That gave him back-to-back DP World Tour wins and entry into the Masters and The Open. Earlier in the season he was 3rd at the Mauritius Open and tied 9th in Bahrain.

Jarvis's recent form before this week was poor. He missed the cut by seven strokes at the Amgen Irish Open (around Sept 13, with a 76 in Round 2) and by one stroke at the BMW PGA Championship (around Sept 20). He did not play the FedEx Open de France. This comes from a search summary, not a page read in full.

recent_facts.source: The Golf News Net / DP World Tour
recent_facts.fact: The event has had 21 different winners since 2001, and Tyrrell Hatton (three wins) is the only player to defend the title. Comebacks happen: Lucas Bjerregaard came from four shots behind in the final round in 2018 to win by one. Sources disagree on who won in 2025 (one names Robert MacIntyre, while PGA Tour calls Fitzpatrick the defending champion), so treat recent winner lists as unverified.
No verified count was found of how often the 36-hole co-leader goes on to win this event. Any such figure should be treated as unverified.

market.question: Will Renan Santos win between 2% and 4% of the valid vote in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
market.rules:
A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the percentage of valid votes received by Renan Santos in the first round of this election.

The percentage of valid votes received by the specified candidate will be determined by dividing the total number of valid votes the candidate receives in the first round by the sum of all valid votes cast in the first round.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

If the specified candidate does not appear on the ballot in the first round, or otherwise receives no valid votes, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

This market will resolve based on the official vote count.

If a recount is initiated before the vote total has been made official, the market will remain open until the recount is completed and the vote is made official.

If the result of this election isn't known definitively by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, including the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).

market.question: US announces end of Iranian blockade by October 15, 2026?
market.rules:
On July 13, 2026, Trump announced the United States would reinstate its naval blockade of Iran, targeting Iranian ships and customers.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if the United States government, or an authorized representative of the United States government, publicly and officially announces the end, termination, lifting, or suspension of the United States’ naval blockade on Iranian ships and ships of Iranian customers, between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

An announcement qualifies if it communicates that the United States will generally cease blocking vessel traffic for Iranian ships and customers, including an announcement that the blockade will not take effect at all, even if some restrictions remain (for example, an imposition of fees). An announcement does not qualify if it reflects only a limited or partial change that stops short of a general end or suspension of the blockade, for example, an exemption for a specific vessel, cargo, or port.

A qualifying announcement must be a declarative statement of the United States government’s present termination or suspension of the blockade, previously-unannounced prior termination or suspension of the blockade, or definitive decision to terminate or suspend the blockade.

A qualifying announcement must clearly and unambiguously identify the end or suspension of the blockade. Statements that merely allude to, reference, or describe an end to the blockade, without clearly communicating it, do not qualify. The announcement need not use specific terminology or reference the end of a blockade by name; an announcement of a resumption of prior obligations, the maintenance of a status quo, or a return to a previously agreed baseline qualifies, provided the substantive policy of ending or suspending the blockade is clearly and unambiguously communicated.

A qualifying announcement must be made through official channels, by an individual acting in an official capacity. Statements made incidentally or informally in a context not intended for official communication do not qualify.

The following do not qualify:

Anonymous, unattributed, or leaked statements not confirmed as official;
Statements by persons not authorized to speak for the United States government;
Third-party speculation, analysis, or predictions that the United States government will announce or implement an end to the blockade;
Satirical, fabricated, hacked, or impersonated communications; and
Statements that describe a prospective, contingent, probable, or conditional end to the blockade rather than announcing a present and decided position.

Once a qualifying announcement is made, this market will resolve to “Yes” regardless of whether it is later reversed, or whether the blockade actually ends in practice.

Resolution will be based on official information from the United States government, including the President, the Department of Defense, the Department of State, and United States Central Command (CENTCOM), or the official representatives of the United States government.

recent_facts.fact: On Oct 1-2, Trump said Iran is "ready to fold up" and suggested the war would end "right after the election," though he added it could end sooner. He said "We blow them up or make a deal." The US is keeping its maritime blockade of Iranian ports in place.

On Oct 1, Trump said Iran's latest peace proposal, which included terms for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, was not enough. He said the US would decide "very soon" whether to strike Iran or negotiate. Iran received Washington's response to its seven-day Hormuz proposal through Qatari mediators.

Trump rejected Iran's seven-day ceasefire plan, saying it "would not be acceptable." Under the plan, the US would lift its blockade of Iranian ports and unfreeze Iranian funds, and Iran would reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days. FM Araghchi said "only a negotiated solution" can end the deadlock.

US and Iranian officials held talks on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York, mediated by Qatar, Pakistan and Egypt. Iran proposed a regionwide ceasefire of up to 60 days, a phased reopening of Hormuz and an end to the US blockade.
Iran's stated conditions for talks with the US are an end to the war on all fronts, the unfreezing of Iranian funds, and an end to the naval blockade.

Iran loaded no crude onto tankers in September 2026, down from about 250,000 bpd in August, the first time this has happened since the war began in February. Kpler and Vortexa also recorded zero loadings.

Treasury imposed new sanctions on Iran's rail and automotive sectors under "Operation Economic Outcast." Three tankers were struck by unknown projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz on Sept 30, and Trump told TIME he doesn't believe "you could ever have peace" with Iran.

The reinstated blockade took effect on July 14, 2026 at 20:00 GMT. By Aug 11, CENTCOM had redirected 55 vessels, and by Sept 12 more than 100 vessels had been redirected since reinstatement. Several tankers (Belma, Lavine, Vela Nova) were disabled.

The previous precedent: the first blockade began April 13, 2026, and was lifted on June 18, 2026, when CENTCOM announced its removal about 66 days later. This came after a deal announced June 14 and signed at Versailles, which started a 60-day clock for a final deal. The blockade was reinstated about 4 weeks later. This is a single case and should not be read as a statistical base rate.

In April 2026, Trump rejected an earlier Iranian proposal and told Axios he would "maintain the blockade in order to pressure Tehran toward a nuclear agreement." The blockade was lifted only after a signed agreement about 7 weeks later.
The June ceasefire/MOU collapsed in less than three weeks, with Iran accusing the US of violating its terms. Trump announced the blockade's reinstatement on July 13.

The US midterm elections are on Nov 3, 2026, after the question closes on Oct 31. Trump has tied resuming strikes or ending the war to the period after the election. Talks through Qatari and Pakistani mediators are ongoing.

market.question: Will Aleksandar Vučić be the next Prime Minister of Serbia?
market.rules:
This market will resolve to the next individual who officially assumes the office of Prime Minister of Serbia by June 30, 2028, 11:59 PM ET.

To count for resolution, the individual must be elected by the National Assembly and be formally sworn-in, resulting in the official formation of a new government. Any interim or caretaker Prime Minister who is not elected by the National Assembly will not count toward the resolution of this market.

If no such Prime Minister takes office by June 30, 2028, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to “Other”.

This market will resolve based on a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve solely based on official information from the Serbian government.

recent_facts.fact: Aleksandar Vučić resigned as President of Serbia on Sept 27, 2026. He did so to lead his Serbian Progressive Party (SNS) in the Oct 25 early parliamentary election as its candidate for prime minister. The constitution barred him from a third presidential term.
SNS formally proposed Vučić as its prime minister if it wins the early election. He heads the list called 'Aleksandar Vučić – United Serbia'.

Vučić dissolved parliament and called early parliamentary elections for Oct 25, 2026. The regular election had been due by December 2027. The question closes the same day, Oct 25, 2026, which is before any new government could be elected by the Assembly.

recent_facts.source: Wikipedia (Opinion polling for the next Serbian parliamentary election)
recent_facts.fact: Latest poll: NSPM (fieldwork Sept 30) has the Student List at 44.4% and SNS/United Serbia at 41.7%. In the previous NSPM poll (July 30) the Student List led 39.6% to 37.5%.

Faktor Plus (fieldwork Sept 16–20, n=986) has SNS/United Serbia at 48.6%, Student List 37.1%, SPS 4.9% and European Serbia 3.6%, with 16% undecided. Its Sept 4 poll had SNS at 47.2% and the Student List at 31.5%.

A CRTA poll published July 15, 2026 had the Student List at 44.9% and SNS at 35.7%. Wikipedia says this was the first regular national poll since July 2010 in which any option other than SNS came first. Different pollsters disagree on who leads: Faktor Plus puts SNS first, while NSPM and CRTA put the Student List first.

All 250 Assembly seats are filled by closed-list proportional representation in one nationwide constituency, using the d'Hondt method. The threshold is 3%, and it is waived for ethnic minority lists. A government needs 126 votes in the National Assembly. 16 lists are running.

The Student List ('Students Win') says it has no leader. Dr. Ilija Srđanović is first on the list, and its candidates include Dejan Bodiroga and former central bank governor Dejan Šoškić. It has not named a prime ministerial candidate, so if it wins, the next PM would be someone other than Vučić.
Ana Brnabić, the parliament speaker and a close Vučić ally, became acting president. She must hold a presidential election within 90 days of the resignation, so no later than Dec 27, 2026.

The current prime minister is Đuro Macut, an independent who took office after Miloš Vučević resigned in January 2025. Wikipedia gives the date as April 16, 2026, which is probably a typo for 2025. Macut is not running as a PM candidate, and there is no mention of a new government being formed before the election.

Unverified, from memory: after recent Serbian elections, new governments were elected roughly 1.5 to 7 months after the vote. Examples: 2014 vote Mar 16, government Apr 27; 2016 Apr 24 to Aug 11; 2020 Jun 21 to Oct 28; 2022 Apr 3 to Oct 26; 2023 Dec 17 to May 2, 2024. SNS won the most seats in every parliamentary election from 2012 to 2023, and Vučić was elected PM in 2014 and 2016.
Polling context: before July 2026, SNS had come first in every regular national poll since July 2010. 2026 is the first election cycle in which polls are split on who will finish first.

Personnel must be physically present on the terrestrial territory of Yemen, including its internal waters. Air or naval operations conducted from outside Yemeni territory, including air strikes, missile strikes, drone strikes and overflights, will not qualify toward a "Yes" resolution.

market.question: Next US-Iran senior diplomatic meeting by October 31, 2026? (copy)
market.rules:
On September 22, U.S. Special Envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York, with President Trump saying another meeting is scheduled in the near future.(see: https://www.israelhayom.com/2026/09/22/witkoff-kushner-attended-us-iran-meeting-another-expected-soon). 

This market will resolve to “Yes” if there is a direct or indirect senior-level diplomatic meeting between the United States and Iran by the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A diplomatic meeting occurs when representatives of both listed countries who are acting in an official capacity and are authorized to engage in diplomacy on behalf of their respective governments or governing authorities deliberately meet for the purpose of diplomacy or negotiation. A qualifying meeting need not result in any agreement, joint statement, or further engagement.

A diplomatic meeting is senior-level if each listed entity is represented by a head of state, a head of government, or a vice president; a foreign minister; a minister of cabinet rank; the secretary or head of a national security council; the presiding officer of a national legislature; a special envoy; or another individual designated by the head of state or head of government to conduct diplomatic negotiations on their behalf. Individuals authorized only for technical, implementation, monitoring, staff-level, preparatory, or working-group-level talks will not be considered designated to conduct diplomatic negotiations on behalf of the head of state or head of government. This definition includes, but is not limited to, all of the following individuals: for the United States, Donald Trump, JD Vance, Marco Rubio, Scott Bessent, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner; and for Iran, Mojtaba Khamenei, Masoud Pezeshkian, Abbas Araghchi and Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf. In each case, a qualifying representative must participate in the meeting.

A direct meeting refers to a diplomatic meeting where the representatives of both countries directly interact with each other in person. Meetings conducted through translators qualify, provided direct, face-to-face communication occurs. An indirect meeting refers to a meeting conducted indirectly through designated mediators or facilitators. A qualifying indirect meeting must meet both of the following criteria (i) the designated intermediaries act with the knowledge and authorization of both entities; (ii) representatives of both entities are physically present in the same facility, venue, or city as part of a single organized round of talks convened for the purpose of diplomatic engagement, with the intermediary conveying communications between the representatives or delegations on the same day. “The same day” means the same calendar day local time at the meeting location.

Sessions, proceedings, or convenings of standing international organizations, treaty bodies, or recurring multilateral summits or conferences (e.g., the United Nations General Assembly, G7, and G20 summits) do not qualify, unless a qualifying and deliberate diplomatic meeting between representatives of the listed countries is separately held alongside such a convening.

The following do not qualify as either a direct or indirect diplomatic meeting: chance encounters; standalone exchanges limited to greetings, courtesies, or photo opportunities; meetings conducted remotely, by telephone, or by any other means where the relevant representatives are not physically present at the same facility, venue, or city on the same day; discussions involving persons not authorized to engage in diplomacy or negotiation on behalf of their respective governments.

The resolution sources for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran and a consensus of credible reporting.

recent_facts.fact: Seasonally adjusted CPI-U rose 0.4% in August 2026, after 0.1% in July. Over 12 months, before seasonal adjustment, it was up 3.4%. In August, energy rose 2.1%, food 0.1%, core 0.3% and shelter 0.3%.

August 2026 gasoline rose 3.9% seasonally adjusted but only 2.5% before adjustment, so seasonal adjustment added to the gasoline gain. Gasoline accounted for over one third of the 0.4% all-items increase.

AAA's national average for regular gasoline was $4.14 on Sept 3, $4.27 on Sept 10, $4.43 on Sept 17 and $4.48 on Sept 24, then $4.396 on Oct 2. AAA said $4.48 was the highest ever for that time of year, driven by volatility in the Strait of Hormuz and high crude prices.

AAA's September 2026 monthly average gas price was reported as $4.33, a record for September and 50 cents above the previous September record. The figure came from a search summary; the AAA page that was read did not state a monthly average.
AAA's August 2026 monthly average gas price was $4.06/gal, a record for August. On this basis, September's $4.33 average would be about 6.7% higher than August before seasonal adjustment.
The question resolves on the single-decimal seasonally adjusted all-items CPI-U monthly change. 'More than 0.6%' requires a published 0.7% or higher; a published 0.6% would resolve No.
The September 2026 CPI report is scheduled for Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET.
Congress passed a continuing resolution funding the government through December 11, 2026 (House vote 370-48; Senate 90-6), so no shutdown began on October 1, 2026.
Monthly seasonally adjusted headline CPI in 2026: March +0.9%, April +0.6%, May +0.5%, June -0.4%, July +0.1%, August +0.4%. Only 1 of these 6 months (March) was above 0.6%.
Energy-to-headline comparisons in 2026: April energy +3.8% came with a 0.6% headline (core +0.4%), and May energy +3.9% came with a 0.5% headline (core +0.2%).

recent_facts.fact: The strike is $2,700. The question resolves Yes only if the Close of the Binance ETH/USDT 1-minute candle at 12:00 ET on Monday 2026-10-05 (16:00 UTC) is strictly higher than $2,700.00. Touching the level before then does not count, and other exchanges' prices are irrelevant.

ETH opened Oct 2 at $2,705.58 and reached $2,747.05 by 7:25 a.m. ET, breaking out of the $2,600 range it had held since Sep 24. BTC rose above $86,000. Yahoo cited short liquidations, easing Treasury yields and a Citigroup $113,000 BTC target as drivers of the morning rally.

The September jobs report, released Oct 2 at 08:30 ET, showed +29,000 payrolls against a consensus of 84,000. The prior two months were revised down by a combined 60,000. Unemployment rose to 4.2% and wage growth was 0.1%.

Treasury yields first fell after the weak jobs report but rose during the session. The 10-year yield was up almost 5 basis points to 5.281% on Oct 2, which fits with ETH giving up its intraday gains in the afternoon. CNBC wrote that the report likely put the brakes on an October Fed rate hike.

Between now and the 16:00 UTC Monday Oct 5 resolving candle, the window covers a weekend (Oct 3–4), which is usually quieter for crypto when US markets are closed. US equity markets reopen at 09:30 ET Monday, 2.5 hours before the resolving minute. No specific scheduled macro release for Oct 3–5 was found in this research.
