This market will resolve to “Yes” if the United States government, or an authorized representative of the United States government, publicly and officially announces the end, termination, lifting, or suspension of the United States’ naval blockade on Iranian ships and ships of Iranian customers, between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

An announcement qualifies if it communicates that the United States will generally cease blocking vessel traffic for Iranian ships and customers, including an announcement that the blockade will not take effect at all, even if some restrictions remain (for example, an imposition of fees). An announcement does not qualify if it reflects only a limited or partial change that stops short of a general end or suspension of the blockade, for example, an exemption for a specific vessel, cargo, or port.

A qualifying announcement must be a declarative statement of the United States government’s present termination or suspension of the blockade, previously-unannounced prior termination or suspension of the blockade, or definitive decision to terminate or suspend the blockade.

A qualifying announcement must clearly and unambiguously identify the end or suspension of the blockade. Statements that merely allude to, reference, or describe an end to the blockade, without clearly communicating it, do not qualify. The announcement need not use specific terminology or reference the end of a blockade by name; an announcement of a resumption of prior obligations, the maintenance of a status quo, or a return to a previously agreed baseline qualifies, provided the substantive policy of ending or suspending the blockade is clearly and unambiguously communicated.

A qualifying announcement must be made through official channels, by an individual acting in an official capacity. Statements made incidentally or informally in a context not intended for official communication do not qualify.

The following do not qualify:

Anonymous, unattributed, or leaked statements not confirmed as official;
Statements by persons not authorized to speak for the United States government;
Third-party speculation, analysis, or predictions that the United States government will announce or implement an end to the blockade;
Satirical, fabricated, hacked, or impersonated communications; and
Statements that describe a prospective, contingent, probable, or conditional end to the blockade rather than announcing a present and decided position.

Once a qualifying announcement is made, this market will resolve to “Yes” regardless of whether it is later reversed, or whether the blockade actually ends in practice.

Resolution will be based on official information from the United States government, including the President, the Department of Defense, the Department of State, and United States Central Command (CENTCOM), or the official representatives of the United States government.

recent_facts.fact: As of the October 2 update, the US blockade of Iranian ports was still in force. Trump said on September 30 that the US had 'virtually total control', which has not been verified. The update also says no active ceasefire negotiations were confirmed as of October 3 and that Qatar is still mediating.

On October 1, Trump rejected Iran's seven-day proposal and insisted that nuclear issues be dealt with first. Iran had offered to reopen the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for the release of about $12 billion in frozen assets, the lifting of oil sanctions and an end to the US blockade.

A source told The National that Iran is preparing for a 'major round of fighting'. Several meetings in New York last month ended without a breakthrough, and both Trump and Iranian officials have signaled they are getting ready for the war to resume. Araghchi said Iran would fight even if it meant an 'apocalyptic' war.

Trump called the Iranian plan 'unacceptable' and described the blockade as 'the greatest blockade in military history -- it's a wall of steel'. The US sent a counterproposal. The two sides disagree on sequencing: Iran wants the US to act first, and Washington wants Iran to reopen the strait first.

Officials said mediators were working on a framework with these terms: reopen the strait with no tolls, lift the US blockade first, remove sanctions afterward, and include Iranian nuclear concessions and inspector access. Officials also said the US had not formally rejected the proposal and that Trump's public rejection may have been a negotiating tactic. Indirect talks were expected to resume on Monday, September 28.

Trump said he expected negotiations with Iran that week even though he had rejected Iran's latest proposal. That proposal was conveyed in indirect talks in New York and tied reopening Hormuz to lifting the blockade, oil-sanctions relief and a regional ceasefire.
Iran loaded no crude onto tankers in September 2026, down from about 250,000 barrels per day in August, because of the US blockade.

recent_facts.source: Wikipedia (2026 United States naval blockade of Iran)
recent_facts.fact: The second phase of the blockade started on July 14, 2026 and is still going on. By September 12, more than 100 ships had been redirected, and several vessels had been disabled, including Belma, Lavine and Vela Nova. The article says the blockade has completely stopped new Iranian oil exports from the Gulf.

Trump said strikes could resume after the November 3 midterm elections 'if negotiations fail'. A third carrier strike group, USS Theodore Roosevelt, is heading to the CENTCOM area. No formal talks with a fixed date before October 15 were found.

Iran dismissed a 15-point US plan covering sanctions relief, nuclear rollback, missile limits and reopening Hormuz. Iran's counterproposal demands war reparations, guarantees against future war and Iranian sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz.

Precedent: the first phase of the blockade ran from April 13 to June 18, 2026, about 66 days. It was lifted the same day a US-Iran memorandum was signed (at Versailles), which extended the ceasefire and started a 60-day negotiation clock. Lifting the blockade was announced at the time the deal took effect.

Trump announced the blockade was being reinstated on July 13, less than a month into the June ceasefire. This followed Iranian attacks on commercial ships in Hormuz starting July 7, and enforcement resumed July 14. Unverified count from this research: the US has announced an end to the blockade once (June 18) and reinstated it once.

market.question: Israel accuses Iran/proxies of plane stabbing incident by Oct 31?
market.rules:
On September 30, 2026, FlyDubai flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv diverted to Saudi Arabia following an incident in the cockpit in which the co-pilot allegedly stabbed the captain. (see: https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/diverted-flydubai-flight-israel-was-not-hijacking-incident-israeli-prime-2026-09-30/).

This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Israeli national government, or an authorized representative of the Israeli national government, publicly announces that Iran or its affiliated groups deliberately caused this incident, by October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

A public announcement refers to an on-the-record statement issued by the Israeli national government or by its authorized representatives acting in an official capacity on behalf of the Israeli national government. A statement or press release issued by the Israeli national government or any of its agencies will qualify. A Prime Minister or Cabinet Minister’s public statements will always be considered to be issued on-the-record in a capacity representing the Israeli national government for purposes of this market. A statement from a lawmaker or other government official speaking in their own capacity or on behalf of a party not in government will not alone qualify.

For purposes of this market, an affiliated group of Iran is: any organization directly controlled by Iran, Hezbollah, Hamas, Palestinian Islamic Jihad, Houthis ("Ansar Allah"), Kata'ib Hezbollah, Asa'ib Ahl al-Haq, Badr Organization, and Harakat al-Nujaba. An unlisted group will only qualify if the Israeli claim itself, or accompanying statements or releases, specifies that the group is a proxy of or otherwise is controlled or directed by Iran. A general statement that it was conducted by an Iranian proxy will also qualify, even if no group is named.

Such a statement will be considered to claim that Iran or its affiliated groups deliberately caused the incident if it explicitly claims that Iran or an affiliated group ordered, carried out, planned, or otherwise directly aided or coordinated the incident. Statements that attribute only inspiration or ideological influence (e.g., "this would not have happened if Iran didn't radicalize terrorists," "the co-pilot was influenced by Hamas' ideas") will not qualify.

Once a qualifying announcement has been made, no subsequent walkback or retraction will be relevant for purposes of this market. 

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the Israeli national government; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

recent_facts.fact: Asked whether Iran was linked to the FlyDubai FZ1073 attack, Prime Minister Netanyahu said: "It's too early to say. The attacking pilot is now being investigated in Saudi Arabia." He said questioning had shown the co-pilot "underwent Islamist radical indoctrination."

A senior Israeli official said the co-pilot most likely acted alone. Two Israeli security officials told Reuters that no evidence of Iranian involvement had been found so far, and the initial assessment was that he acted independently. The investigation is still open.

Despite Trump's remarks, a senior Israeli official said on Thursday that investigators have so far ruled out an apparent connection to Iran. Reports describe a growing assessment that he acted alone for nationalist reasons. That assessment has not been confirmed.

Trump said he had reason to believe Iran was involved: "Based on what I'm hearing is yes, but we're working on it right now." Israeli officials said they currently have no indications of Iranian involvement but have not ruled it out.

Trump said the US would strike Iran "very hard" if a Tehran link were established, but he made no definitive accusation. An Israeli official said the co-pilot's social media showed he had been "radicalised into jihadist ideology" and talked about killing Jews. Reports say leaflets from "Free Palestine groups" were found with him, but no formal link to any organization has been confirmed.

Netanyahu's spokesman alleged the attack was meant to undermine the Abraham Accords and disrupt Israel's election. He gave no evidence and did not say whether the suspect was directed by Iran or any other organization.

The Omani co-pilot was suspended by Oman Air in 2024, when he was a co-pilot trainee, after extremist materials were found with him. He later joined FlyDubai, where he had worked for about 5 to 9 months.

After medical clearance, the suspect was moved from Saudi Arabia to Abu Dhabi. The UAE is leading the investigation and is examining whether the attack was terrorism, and whether he was a lone attacker or was directed by outside actors.

Israel, Oman, Saudi Arabia, the UAE and the United States have opened investigations, and the motive is still undetermined. No date has been announced for findings. The question closes on October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET.

Al Jazeera reports that the attack gives Netanyahu a new security message ahead of an upcoming Israeli election vote. This sets the political context in which Israeli government statements about the incident will be made.
The stabbing came in a region already shaken by a recent US-Iran war. Iran's state outlet Press TV called the incident a Netanyahu plot to drag the US into war with Iran.

To count, the Israeli government must explicitly say Iran or a listed proxy ordered, carried out, planned, or directly aided or coordinated the attack. Netanyahu's statements so far describe only radicalization.

market.question: Will Bitcoin be above $100000 by November 1, 2026 at 12:00AM ET? (Before November 2026)
market.rules:
If the Bitcoin spot price according to the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index is above $100000.00 starting Jul 21, 2026 and before Nov 1, 2026 at 12:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
The market resolves based on the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index (BRTI) using a trimmed mean calculation. The resolution value is calculated by taking all BRTI values for each minute from market issuance until the specified time on the target date, removing the top 20% and bottom 20% of values, then averaging the remaining 60% of values. If the BRTI crosses the threshold at any point during the measurement period (triggering early expiration), the market immediately resolves. If no data is available at the expiration time, the market resolves to No. The market can resolve early if Bitcoin definitively crosses the threshold before the target date and time.

market.question: Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the October 2026 meeting?
market.rules:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's October 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for October 27-28, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their October meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

recent_facts.fact: At its September 15-16, 2026 meeting, the FOMC voted unanimously to raise the federal funds target range by 25 bps to 3.75%-4.00%. It was the Fed's first rate hike since July 2023, and 3.75%-4.00% is the baseline the October change will be measured against.
The next FOMC meeting is October 27-28, 2026, and the statement comes out on October 28. If the upper bound of the range is raised from 4.00% to 4.25%, that counts as a 25 bp increase.

The September 2026 jobs report showed 29,000 jobs added, below the Dow Jones consensus of 84,000. Unemployment rose to 4.2% from an expected 4.1%. August was revised down to +133,000 and July to -10,000, a combined downward revision of 60,000 jobs.
NY Fed President John Williams said there is 'no need for urgency' on changing policy. He suggested 'one further upward adjustment' may be appropriate late this year rather than in October.

Vice Chair Philip Jefferson said future adjustments should come from 'carefully examining trends in the data' and that coming to a judgment 'may take more time.' Minneapolis Fed President Kashkari said he had no strong view on an October hike and projected one more hike this year. Dallas Fed President Logan called the September hike a 'first step.'
Reporting said top Fed policymakers do not expect to deliver back-to-back hikes at the October meeting. Global brokerages now largely expect the next hike in December rather than October.
The August PCE price index rose 3.4% year over year. That is far above the Fed's 2% goal but no worse than July's reading.

At his roughly 30-minute September 16 press conference, Chair Warsh said 'inflation is too high and has been for too long' and promised a 'timelier return' to 2%. He declined to commit to further hikes and kept forward guidance limited.
CNN described the September hike as Warsh defying President Trump, who wants lower rates. The hike was driven by inflation tied to rising oil prices and Middle East tensions.
The September 2026 CPI report is scheduled for October 14, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. ET, two weeks before the October 28 FOMC decision.
The question resolves on the change in the upper bound of the range in the October 28 FOMC statement. If no statement is released, it resolves to 'No change.'

facts_dropped.fact: The September Summary of Economic Projections showed officials signaling one more hike in 2026, and some participants projected two more. The median 2027 fed funds projection was about 4.1%. One summary gave inconsistent counts of '16 of 18 one more hike / 4 two hikes', so treat the exact distribution as unverified.

market.question: NATO x Russia military clash by October 31, 2026?
market.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if there is a military encounter between the military forces of a NATO country and Russia between market creation and October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

A "military encounter" is defined as any incident involving the use of force such as missile strikes, artillery fire, exchange of gunfire, or other forms of direct military engagement between NATO and Russian military forces. Non-violent actions, such as airspace violations, firing of warning shots (such as the June, 2021 Black Sea Confrontations between Russian forces and HMS Defender), or cyberattacks will not qualify.

Interception of missiles or other one-way attack or loitering munitions (e.g. Shahed drones) which are targeting a 3rd party other than the listed countries or their respective forces will not alone qualify. Shooting down UAVs which are not munitions (e.g. MQ-9, Orlan 10, Orion, Bayraktar TB2, etc.) will qualify.

Intentional physical collisions, including aerial interceptions and naval ramming without the direct use of weaponry, such as the 2023 Black Sea incident—where a Russian Su-27 damaged a U.S. MQ-9 Reaper drone's propeller, leading to its crash— will not qualify regardless of damage.

Military contractors will qualify only if confirmed to be operating under the direct command or coordination of the respective state’s armed forces (e.g. the Battle of Khasham would not qualify).

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

market.question: Bab el-Mandeb Strait effectively closed by October 31?
market.rules:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if IMF PortWatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Bab el-Mandeb Strait less than or equal to 10 for any date between market creation and the listed date. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This market will resolve as soon as IMF PortWatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls for the Bab el-Mandeb Strait equal to or below 10, or once data has been published for the listed date and no such value has been published.

If no data has been published for the listed date within 14 calendar days (ET) after that date, this market will resolve based on the data published up to that point.

Revisions to previously published data points made before data has been published for the listed date will be considered; however, they will not disqualify a previously published data point from qualifying. Revisions made after data has been published for the listed date will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market will be IMF PortWatch, specifically the “Arrivals of Ships” data published for the Bab el-Mandeb Strait at https://portwatch.imf.org/pages/6b1814d64903461b98144a6cc25eb79c.

recent_facts.fact: Bab el-Mandeb had 290 transits in 21–27 Sep 2026 (preliminary) and 264 in 14–20 Sep. The 4-week average was 280 per week, against 316 in June and 257 in January. LLI counts only cargo-carrying vessels over 10,000 dwt, which is a different method from IMF PortWatch.

recent_facts.source: Web search summary (unverified, primary source not retrieved)
recent_facts.fact: One secondary summary said the PortWatch 7-day average for Bab el-Mandeb reached a low of 11 around June 18, 2026, just above the threshold of 10. Unverified; we could not confirm it on PortWatch.
As of March 10, 2026, the 7-day average of Bab el-Mandeb transits, citing PortWatch data, was 20.57 crossings.

At the height of the 2023–24 Houthi campaign, LLI's weekly low for all vessel types through Bab el-Mandeb was 218 passings, in the week ending March 10, 2024. Traffic fell but never stopped during that campaign.
The Houthis seized Mokha on Sep 10 and Perim Island, in the middle of the strait, on Sep 11–12, 2026. Houthi spokesman Yahya Sarea said navigation is safe for all companies except Saudi ships.

recent_facts.source: Africa Center for Strategic Studies / Asia Times

This market will resolve according to the percentage of valid votes received by Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round of this election.

The percentage of valid votes received by the specified candidate will be determined by dividing the total number of valid votes the candidate receives in the first round by the sum of all valid votes cast in the first round.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

If the specified candidate does not appear on the ballot in the first round, or otherwise receives no valid votes, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

This market will resolve based on the official vote count.

If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, including the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).

market.question: Saudi Oil Pipeline (East-West) restarts by October 15?
market.rules:
On September 11, 2026, Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Energy announced that the East-West oil pipeline has been shut down.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if the government of Saudi Arabia announces that the East-West oil pipeline is operational or no longer shut down between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A qualifying announcement must express that the pipeline is presently operating; operation at partial or reduced capacity qualifies.

Announcements that attribute such a claim to third parties, state that the pipeline will or may operate in the future, describe work underway to restore operation, or frame resumption as expected, planned, or conditional, will not qualify.

Once a qualifying announcement is made, this market will resolve to “Yes,” regardless of any subsequent contradictory statements, or alternative information from other sources.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the government of Saudi Arabia.

recent_facts.source: Hydrocarbon Processing / industry press summary (via search)
recent_facts.fact: Late-September reporting said neither the Saudi Energy Ministry nor state-owned Saudi Aramco had made any public statement about the pipeline since the attack. News of the restart came from industry sources and intelligence gathering, not from an official government announcement. The exact publication date is approximate.

Three unnamed sources said the East-West pipeline had restarted and was pumping at a low rate, with Aramco aiming to get back to 4 million bpd. Aramco did not respond to a request for comment, and the article cites no official Saudi statement.

The question resolves Yes only if the Saudi government itself announces that the pipeline is operating now, and partial capacity counts. Reports that cite third parties or anonymous sources do not count, so the September 22 Reuters reports do not qualify by themselves. The rules don't say whether a statement from state-owned Aramco counts as the 'government of Saudi Arabia'.

The Ministry of Energy said the East-West Pipeline had been shut down as a precaution after multiple attacks on the morning of September 10, 2026 in the Riyadh and Madinah regions. It said emergency and technical teams were securing the pipeline and assessing its safety.
Saudi Arabia shut the 7 million bpd East-West crude pipeline after multiple drone attacks. The Saudi Foreign Ministry said some of the drones came from Iraq.

Reports said Aramco had raised East-West flows above 80% of capacity, close to 6 million bpd of the 7 million bpd line, leaving about 4.5 million bpd for export. The figures are sourced to industry reports, not a government statement, and the publication date is approximate (late September).

Tanker tracking showed crude loadings had resumed at Yanbu, and Aramco sent customers its October Yanbu loading schedule. ESA satellite imagery from September 27 showed nearly 10 million barrels being loaded at Yanbu and Al Muajjiz. The publication date is approximate.

Throughput was estimated at about 2 million bpd by industry sources and about 2.65 million bpd by Kpler. Pre-attack flows were about 5.5 million bpd, and sources said a full recovery could take about another month. The publication date is approximate.

Bloomberg and the WSJ reported the pipeline carrying about 3.5 million bpd, roughly half its pre-attack volume. These are media reports, not a Saudi government announcement. The publication date is approximate.

Precedent from earlier this year: after Iranian strikes damaged a pumping station following the Feb 28 US-Israeli strikes on Iran, the Ministry of Energy issued an official SPA statement on April 12, 2026. It announced that full pumping capacity of about 7 million bpd had been restored on the East-West pipeline.

In April, Saudi Arabia publicly said the pipeline was back to full capacity after the attacks, showing the ministry has made official restoration announcements before. That precedent is a single case.

Aramco CEO Amin Nasser publicly said Aramco could restore disrupted flows within days and had never failed to supply a customer. The search summary does not show him saying the East-West pipeline is currently operating. The date is approximate.
A qualifying official Saudi announcement has to come by October 15, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. No scheduled government event tied to the pipeline was found before then.

market.question: Will Jerônimo Rodrigues win the 2026 Bahia gubernatorial election?
market.rules:
The Bahia gubernatorial election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026, with a runoff on October 25, 2026, if no candidate receives a majority of the valid votes in the first round.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

Temporary, interim, or placeholder governors appointed by any means before the specified election will not be considered.

If the result of this election isn't known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., www.tse.jus.br/eleicoes/resultados-eleicoes).

recent_facts.fact: AtlasIntel/A Tarde's last poll before the vote, released October 3, had Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) at 51.5% of valid votes in the first round and ACM Neto (União Brasil) at 47.4%. Its runoff scenario had Jerônimo at 52.1% and ACM Neto at 47.9%.

Paraná Pesquisas (fieldwork Sept 29–Oct 2, released Oct 3) had ACM Neto at 46.4% and Jerônimo at 44.6% of total voting intentions. The 1.8-point gap is inside its ±2.7-point margin of error. On valid votes, Jornal Grande Bahia reported this as ACM Neto 50.3% and Jerônimo 48.4%.
A Veritá poll reported around September 29 had ACM Neto at 51.1% of valid votes and Jerônimo at 47.7%. The page headline gives ACM Neto 51.3%.
Quaest (fieldwork Sept 20–23, ±3 points) had ACM Neto at 42% and Jerônimo at 40% of total voting intentions, or 50.6% to 48.2% of valid votes. Its runoff scenario had ACM Neto 45% and Jerônimo 43%.
Quaest ran its last pre-election Bahia poll on October 2–3 (2,004 interviews) for release on October 3. I could not find its numbers in my searches.

Late-September polls (Jerônimo vs ACM Neto, total intentions): Real Time Big Data Sept 9, 45% vs 44%; Quaest Sept 20–23, 40% vs 42%; Paraná Pesquisas Sept 21–23, 42% vs 46.7%; Real Time Big Data Sept 23–26, 47% vs 43%; AtlasIntel Sept 24–28, 49% vs 45.9%.
Datafolha (fieldwork Sept 4–8, ±2 points) had Jerônimo at 45% and ACM Neto at 44% in the first round, and 46% to 45% in a runoff.

Quaest in July 2026 had ACM Neto 39%, Jerônimo 38%, Aroldo Felix (UP) 1% and Ronaldo Mansur (PSOL) 1%, with 13% undecided. The race is essentially a two-way contest, so whoever wins a majority of valid votes on October 4 takes it outright. In the same poll, Lula had 52% for president in Bahia.

In 2022, Jerônimo won the first round with 49.45% to ACM Neto's 40.80% (João Roma had 9.08%), then won the runoff 52.79% to 47.21%. ACM Neto had led most major polls in that race, with Datafolha in late August showing 54% for ACM Neto and 16% for Jerônimo.

Jornal Grande Bahia notes that AtlasIntel had already shown Jerônimo leading in Bahia in 2022, when most other pollsters showed ACM Neto ahead. This is one election, so it is an unverified single-case track record.

PT has won every Bahia governor election since 2006: Wagner in 2006 and 2010, Rui Costa in 2014 and 2018, and Jerônimo in 2022, five in a row. This list is from memory and unverified. Jerônimo is the incumbent running for re-election.

López Aliaga, who was Lima's mayor until 2025, is registered as first councillor (primer regidor) on Renovación Popular's list. Carlos Bruce took his complaint about a possible disguised re-election of López Aliaga to the OAS (Organization of American States).

Allison has been mayor of Magdalena del Mar for several terms over about 20 years and was briefly Housing Minister under Alan García. He was once arrested in the US for carrying more than $50,000 in cash and pleaded guilty to smuggling and perjury charges.
Allison said that if elected he would audit López Aliaga's administration, saying there were 'very clear signs of corruption'.
Campaigning closed on Oct 2. The municipal election is on Sunday, October 4, 2026, and ONPE (the national elections office) will publish the official count afterwards.

market.question: Will Tesla or SpaceX announce a definitive, binding agreement for Tesla to acquire SpaceX, SpaceX to acquire Tesla, or the two entities to merge or combine in any structure that results in a transfer of controlling interest or consolidation of the two entities under common corporate ownership before Nov 1, 2026? (Before Nov 1, 2026)
market.rules:
If Tesla or SpaceX officially announces a definitive, binding agreement for Tesla to acquire SpaceX, SpaceX to acquire Tesla, or the two entities to merge or combine in any structure that results in a transfer of controlling interest or consolidation of the two entities under common corporate ownership before Nov 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
The announcement must be made through official company channels including press releases, SEC filings (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q), earnings calls, investor presentations, verified social media accounts, or official statements to media subsequently confirmed by the company. CEO statements through official channels qualify. Rumors, speculation, unconfirmed reports, leaked information, third-party announcements without company confirmation, and preliminary discussions do not qualify. The announcement must occur after market issuance. Companies are tracked through rebranding and name changes representing the same business entity.

This market resolves Yes regardless of which entity is the acquirer and which is the target. A Tesla acquisition of SpaceX, a SpaceX acquisition of Tesla, a reverse merger, or a stock-for-stock combination all satisfy the Payout Criterion equally, provided a definitive agreement is publicly announced.

A statement by Elon Musk shall only satisfy the Payout Criterion if it constitutes an unambiguous, affirmative confirmation of a definitive signed agreement — not an expression of intent, a hypothetical, a negotiation update, or a speculative comment about a future combination.

recent_facts.fact: As of September 29, 2026, Tesla and SpaceX had not announced a merger and had made no formal statements about merger negotiations. The article puts SpaceX's market value at about $2 trillion and Tesla's at about $1.47 trillion.

The SEC approved Tesla's 'Issuer Voluntary Retail Voting Program'. Under it, retail shareholders can have their shares voted automatically in line with the board's recommendations. Coverage tied this to a possible future shareholder vote on a SpaceX merger.
Tesla had not yet set a date for its 2026 annual shareholder meeting. Its April 2026 filing said 'the board has not yet established the date.' The previous meeting was on November 6, 2025.

Tesla will release Q3 2026 results after the market closes on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, followed by a webcast at 5:30 p.m. ET. Earnings calls count as an official channel under the resolution rules.

On Tesla's Q2 2026 earnings call, Musk pointed to 'more and more overlap' between Tesla and SpaceX. He also said 'we can't talk about combining companies and that kind of thing on an earnings call, it has got to be done with the appropriate process.'

The WSJ reported that Tesla was weighing a sale of its China business to clear the way for a SpaceX deal. Musk called the report 'absurdly fake news' and said a separation had 'never even come up in a discussion ever.'

Coverage identifies China as the main hurdle to a deal. Tesla's Shanghai plant produces more than half of Tesla's global deliveries. U.S. government sales made up 20.9% of SpaceX's 2025 revenue, including national-security work through Starshield, and SpaceX's IPO excluded orders from mainland China and Hong Kong.

Recent coverage says the two companies are preparing for a megamerger, citing reporters and experts. It also says what has been discussed has not been made public, the deal's structure and timing are unclear, and company representatives have not confirmed talks.
Ahead of SpaceX's IPO, reports said Musk had discussed folding SpaceX and Tesla together with colleagues. SpaceX went public in June 2026.

Tesla holds an equity stake in SpaceX. Earlier in 2026 the two companies signed a 'framework agreement' on future collaboration. That is a collaboration agreement, not a merger agreement, and they also share projects such as the Terafab chip plant.

Musk-company precedent: Reuters reported SpaceX–xAI merger talks on January 29, 2026, and SpaceX announced it had acquired xAI on February 2, 2026, four days later. It was an all-stock deal valuing the combined company at $1.25 trillion.

In January 2026, reports described SpaceX combining with either Tesla or xAI. The xAI combination happened within days, while the Tesla combination has gone more than 8 months without being announced.

UNVERIFIED, from memory, and the linked page does not support it: Tesla's acquisition of SolarCity, another related-party deal involving Musk, went from a public offer in June 2016 to a definitive agreement on August 1, 2016, about 6 weeks, using a special committee process.

Only an official announcement of a signed, definitive agreement counts. Hints from Musk such as his July 2026 'overlap' comments, reports of talks, or announcements of a special committee or review would not resolve the question Yes.

market.question: Will the rate of CPI inflation be above 3.5% for the year ending in September 2026? (Above 3.5%)
market.rules:
If the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increases by more than 3.5% in the twelve months ending September 2026 (as represented by the one-decimal place value reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics), then the market resolves to Yes.
In the case of a delay in data caused by a federal government shutdown impacting the reliability of the Source Agency, the market’s latest Expiration Date will be extended to the sooner of the release of the Underlying or six months after the end of the
government shutdown

recent_facts.fact: August 2026 CPI-U rose 3.4% over 12 months before seasonal adjustment, the same as in July. The NSA index was 334.980, against 323.976 in August 2025. The seasonally adjusted monthly change was +0.4%.

recent_facts.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (via DOL)
recent_facts.fact: The September 2025 CPI-U NSA index was 324.800, up 3.0% y/y. That puts the Aug-to-Sep 2025 NSA rise at about +0.25%, from 323.976. This is the base the September 2026 y/y figure is measured against.

recent_facts.source: Derived arithmetic from BLS index levels
recent_facts.fact: For the published y/y to round to 3.7% or higher, the September 2026 NSA index must exceed about 336.655 (324.800 × 1.0365). That requires an Aug-to-Sep 2026 NSA rise of about +0.50% from 334.980. A rise of about +0.40% (index about 336.33) would give roughly 3.55–3.6%. A rise near +0.25%, the same as last September, would leave y/y near 3.4%.
Gasoline accounted for over one third of the 0.4% monthly all-items increase in August 2026.
EIA monthly average U.S. regular retail gasoline: June 2026 $4.050, July $3.932, August $4.058, September $4.355. That makes September about 7.3% above August.

AAA's September 2026 monthly average gas price was $4.33, a record for September and 50 cents above the previous record of $3.83 set in 2023. The national average was $4.41 on Oct 1, down nearly 7 cents in a week, and crude was in the $90/barrel range.
AAA's national average climbed through September 2026: $4.14 on Sep 3, $4.27 on Sep 10, $4.43 on Sep 17 and $4.48 on Sep 24, the highest ever for that time of year.

AAA reported August 2026 as the most expensive August on record, with the national average above $4 every day. The mid-month August average was $4.06, and a secondary summary gave $4.19 for the full month; the two AAA-derived figures disagree, so this one is unverified.
September 2026 CPI is scheduled for release on Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET, which is 12:30 UTC. The question closes at 12:29 UTC that day.
The question resolves on the one-decimal 12-month NSA all-items CPI-U change BLS reports for September 2026. It must be strictly above 3.6%, so 3.6% resolves No and 3.7% or higher resolves Yes.

market.question: Next US-Iran senior diplomatic meeting by October 31, 2026? (copy)
market.rules:
On September 22, U.S. Special Envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York, with President Trump saying another meeting is scheduled in the near future.(see: https://www.israelhayom.com/2026/09/22/witkoff-kushner-attended-us-iran-meeting-another-expected-soon). 

This market will resolve to “Yes” if there is a direct or indirect senior-level diplomatic meeting between the United States and Iran by the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A diplomatic meeting occurs when representatives of both listed countries who are acting in an official capacity and are authorized to engage in diplomacy on behalf of their respective governments or governing authorities deliberately meet for the purpose of diplomacy or negotiation. A qualifying meeting need not result in any agreement, joint statement, or further engagement.

A diplomatic meeting is senior-level if each listed entity is represented by a head of state, a head of government, or a vice president; a foreign minister; a minister of cabinet rank; the secretary or head of a national security council; the presiding officer of a national legislature; a special envoy; or another individual designated by the head of state or head of government to conduct diplomatic negotiations on their behalf. Individuals authorized only for technical, implementation, monitoring, staff-level, preparatory, or working-group-level talks will not be considered designated to conduct diplomatic negotiations on behalf of the head of state or head of government. This definition includes, but is not limited to, all of the following individuals: for the United States, Donald Trump, JD Vance, Marco Rubio, Scott Bessent, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner; and for Iran, Mojtaba Khamenei, Masoud Pezeshkian, Abbas Araghchi and Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf. In each case, a qualifying representative must participate in the meeting.

A direct meeting refers to a diplomatic meeting where the representatives of both countries directly interact with each other in person. Meetings conducted through translators qualify, provided direct, face-to-face communication occurs. An indirect meeting refers to a meeting conducted indirectly through designated mediators or facilitators. A qualifying indirect meeting must meet both of the following criteria (i) the designated intermediaries act with the knowledge and authorization of both entities; (ii) representatives of both entities are physically present in the same facility, venue, or city as part of a single organized round of talks convened for the purpose of diplomatic engagement, with the intermediary conveying communications between the representatives or delegations on the same day. “The same day” means the same calendar day local time at the meeting location.

Sessions, proceedings, or convenings of standing international organizations, treaty bodies, or recurring multilateral summits or conferences (e.g., the United Nations General Assembly, G7, and G20 summits) do not qualify, unless a qualifying and deliberate diplomatic meeting between representatives of the listed countries is separately held alongside such a convening.

The following do not qualify as either a direct or indirect diplomatic meeting: chance encounters; standalone exchanges limited to greetings, courtesies, or photo opportunities; meetings conducted remotely, by telephone, or by any other means where the relevant representatives are not physically present at the same facility, venue, or city on the same day; discussions involving persons not authorized to engage in diplomacy or negotiation on behalf of their respective governments.

The resolution sources for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran and a consensus of credible reporting.

market.question: Will Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva win the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
market.rules:
A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the listed candidate that wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If the result of this election isn't known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).

recent_facts.source: Jornal do Brasil (Datafolha for Folha/TV Globo)
recent_facts.fact: In Datafolha's final pre-election poll (Sept 28–Oct 1, 2,506 voters), Lula has 45% of valid first-round votes and Flávio Bolsonaro 40%. Cury has 4%, Caiado 3%, Renan Santos 3%, and Zema, Samara Martins and Grassi 1% each. In total votes it is 42% to 38%.

In Datafolha's simulated runoff, Lula has 48% and Flávio Bolsonaro 45%, with blank/null at 6% and undecided at 1%. With a ±2 pt margin of error this is a technical tie. The previous Datafolha poll (Sept 24) had 47% to 45%.

AtlasIntel's Sept 29 survey has a runoff tied at 50% to 50%. Its Sept 23 survey had Lula 50.2% to Flávio 49.8% of valid votes. AtlasIntel's September first-round figures were Lula 46.2% and Flávio 43.1%.

A candidate wins in the first round only with more than half of valid votes. Otherwise the top two go to a runoff on October 25, 2026. That date is after these questions close (2026-10-05 03:59 UTC), but the markets include any runoff.

The first round is October 4, 2026, and the runoff if needed is October 25, 2026. The main candidates are Lula (PT, incumbent), Flávio Bolsonaro (PL, endorsed by imprisoned Jair Bolsonaro), Caiado (PSD), Cury (Avante) and Zema (Novo), plus seven minor candidates.

UNVERIFIED, from memory: incumbent presidents running for re-election in Brazil won 3 of 4 times: FHC in 1998, Lula in 2006 and Dilma in 2014. Bolsonaro lost in 2022, 49.1% to 50.9%. Since 1989, 7 of 9 presidential elections went to a runoff.

On September 1, leaked private messages between Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes and a banker set off an institutional crisis. Through mid-September it grew into a standoff involving several justices and the Federal Police director, overshadowing campaign coverage.

market.question: Will Rafael López Aliaga win the next Lima mayoral elections?
market.rules:
The 2026 Lima, Peru mayoral election is currently scheduled to be held on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who becomes the next Mayor of Lima as a result of this election.

Temporary, interim, or placeholder mayors appointed before the election will not be considered.

If the result of this election isn't known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting; however, if there is any ambiguity in the results, this market will resolve according to official information from the Peruvian government, including the National Jury of Elections (Jurado Nacional de Elecciones, JNE, https://jne.gob.pe) and the National Office of Electoral Processes (Oficina Nacional de Procesos Electorales, ONPE, https://www.onpe.gob.pe/).

recent_facts.fact: The Lima mayoral race is decided in a single round with no runoff, so the candidate with the most votes wins. There are 26 candidates.

López Aliaga, who was Lima's mayor until 2025, is registered as first councillor (primer regidor) on Renovación Popular's list. The list's mayoral nominee resigned, which makes him first in line to become mayor. Critics call this a disguised re-election that gets around the constitutional ban on immediate re-election.
The JNE (National Jury of Elections) confirmed López Aliaga's candidacy and rejected an appeal to exclude him. It said no challenge had been filed within the three-day deadline.
Days before the vote, the JNE had still not said whether it would give López Aliaga the mayor's credential if his list wins. APRA candidate Mónica Yaya asked Congress to call the JNE in to clarify.
Carlos Bruce took his complaint about a possible disguised re-election of López Aliaga to the OAS (Organization of American States).

Allison has been mayor of Magdalena del Mar for several terms over about 20 years and was briefly Housing Minister under Alan García. He was once arrested in the US for carrying more than $50,000 in cash and pleaded guilty to smuggling and perjury charges.
Allison said that if elected he would audit López Aliaga's administration, saying there were 'very clear signs of corruption'.
Campaigning closed on Oct 2. The municipal election is on Sunday, October 4, 2026, and ONPE (the national elections office) will publish the official count afterwards.

market.question: Will Renan Santos win between 2% and 4% of the valid vote in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
market.rules:
A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the percentage of valid votes received by Renan Santos in the first round of this election.

The percentage of valid votes received by the specified candidate will be determined by dividing the total number of valid votes the candidate receives in the first round by the sum of all valid votes cast in the first round.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

If the specified candidate does not appear on the ballot in the first round, or otherwise receives no valid votes, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

This market will resolve based on the official vote count.

If a recount is initiated before the vote total has been made official, the market will remain open until the recount is completed and the vote is made official.

If the result of this election isn't known definitively by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, including the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).

recent_facts.fact: In Datafolha's final pre-election poll (2,506 interviews, Sep 28–Oct 1, margin ±2 pts), Renan Santos (Missão) had 3% of total votes and 3% of valid votes in the stimulated first-round scenario. He had 2% in the spontaneous scenario.

AtlasIntel's Sep 23–28 poll (5,005 respondents, margin ±1 pt) gave Renan Santos 5.3% of valid votes. Lula had 46.2%, Flávio Bolsonaro 43.1%, Augusto Cury 2.1%, Ronaldo Caiado 1.8% and Romeu Zema 0.9%.

recent_facts.source: Wikipedia, Opinion polling for the 2026 Brazilian presidential election

The page lists that AtlasIntel 5.2% as his highest polling figure. None of these listed polls has him at 8% or more.
Quaest's last pre-election poll (3,702 voters, Oct 2–3, margin about ±2 pts) was still to be released before the vote. The first round is on Sunday, October 4, 2026.

recent_facts.source: Gazeta do Povo / O Liberal (AtlasIntel Bahia poll)
recent_facts.fact: In an AtlasIntel poll of Bahia state voters (Sep 27–Oct 2), Renan Santos had 1.9% of valid votes for president.
Renan Santos filed a complaint with the TSE asking to join TV Globo's final presidential debate, arguing he met the Quaest-based criteria with 3%. In the end he did not take part in the debate.

recent_facts.fact: In 2022 the third- and fourth-place candidates did worse than in Datafolha's final poll. Ciro Gomes polled 5% and got 3.0% of valid votes; Simone Tebet polled 6% and got 4.2%. It is not confirmed whether those Datafolha figures were total-vote or valid-vote shares, and this rests on just 2 cases.

recent_facts.fact: ALDS Game 1 at Tropicana Field was in progress when checked: the Rays led 1-0 in the 3rd inning on a Jonathan Aranda home run. Rasmussen had thrown 3.0 no-hit innings with 4 strikeouts, and Cole had allowed 1 run in 2.1 innings. One search snippet claimed a 6-1 Rays final, but no posted final confirmed it, so treat the result as unverified.

The series is best-of-five, so the first team to 3 wins takes it, and Tampa Bay has home-field advantage. The questions resolve on whichever team wins the series, and exactly one of Yankees or Rays will resolve Yes.

Game 1 is Oct 3 and Game 2 is Oct 5, both at Tampa Bay. Games 3 (Oct 7) and 4 (Oct 8, if necessary) are at Yankee Stadium, and Game 5 (Oct 10, if necessary) is back at Tropicana Field. All games air on TBS/truTV.
The Rays won the AL East at 98-64. The Yankees finished 93-68 (one game rained out), 4.5 games back, and were the top AL Wild Card seed.
The Yankees swept the Red Sox 2-0 in the AL Wild Card Series at Yankee Stadium, winning 9-0 and 9-2. Tampa Bay had a first-round bye.

Aaron Judge is not on the Yankees' ALDS roster, the second straight round he has been left off, while he recovers from a right calf strain. He had not played since Sept. 16 and had not yet run the bases. The Yankees averaged 5.12 runs per game with him in the lineup this season and 4.22 without him.
Tampa Bay won the 2026 regular-season series 7-6, but New York won four of the last five meetings. 13 games is a small sample.

Rasmussen's regular-season career line against the Yankees is 5-2 with a 1.81 ERA and 0.86 WHIP over 11 games (10 starts). In his last regular-season start he took a no-hitter into the 7th with 11 strikeouts in the Rays' division-clinching win at Yankee Stadium. Cole, back from Tommy John surgery, went 10-9 with a 3.61 ERA in 22 starts and allowed 3 runs or fewer in each of his 3 starts against Tampa Bay this season.
The Yankees are expected to start Cam Schlittler in Game 2. Tampa Bay had not yet named its Game 2 starter.
The Yankees carried 10 pitchers in the Wild Card Series and added an 11th for the ALDS: Ryan Weathers, back from a left flexor strain.

Under the current format (2022-2024), teams with a first-round bye went 6-6 in Division Series. Per the same search results, bye teams went 3-1 in 2025, which would make it 9 of 16 since 2022 (my tally from the summary; unverified and a small sample).
This is only the second postseason series between the clubs. Tampa Bay won the only previous one, the 2020 ALDS (a single series, so background only).

Croatia host Spain in Nations League League A Group 3, Matchday 4, on Tuesday 6 October 2026 at 20:45 CEST (18:45 UTC). The venue is Stadion Poljud in Split (about 34,000 capacity), so Spain are the away side.
One week before this match, Spain beat Croatia 4-1 in Seville in the reverse fixture. Lamine Yamal scored twice and Pubill and Nico Williams also scored. Beljo scored Croatia's equaliser at 1-1.

Matchday 1 results: Spain won 3-2 against England at Wembley after coming from behind, and Croatia won 2-1 in Prague against Czechia. Before the Seville match, Al Jazeera reported Spain had won 5 in a row and described a 39-game run as a European record. That claim is unverified. Croatia's last five read W-L-W-W-L.
After two matchdays Spain led Group A3 with 6 points from 2 wins, three points clear. Czechia were bottom.
Spain host Czechia in Oviedo (Estadio Carlos Tartiere) on Saturday 3 October 2026 at 20:45 local time, three days before the Split match. No result had been found when this was researched.

Al Jazeera gives the head-to-head before 29 September as 11 meetings: Spain 6 wins, Croatia 3, 2 draws. Another preview gave it as Spain 5 wins to Croatia 2, so the sources disagree. With Seville added, Spain have won 7 of 12 under Al Jazeera's count. That is a small sample.
Croatia's last win over Spain was 3-2 at home in the Nations League in November 2018. It is the most recent meeting in Croatia that the previews mention.
Spain are the reigning world champions after beating Argentina in the 2026 World Cup final on 19 July.

Luis de la Fuente named a 26-man squad built around Rodri, Pedri, Dani Olmo, Lamine Yamal, Nico Williams and Oyarzabal. Joan García (knee), Gavi and Borja Iglesias (fitness) were left out, and Marcos Llorente has retired from international football.

A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the percentage of valid votes received by Renan Santos in the first round of this election.

The percentage of valid votes received by the specified candidate will be determined by dividing the total number of valid votes the candidate receives in the first round by the sum of all valid votes cast in the first round.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

If the specified candidate does not appear on the ballot in the first round, or otherwise receives no valid votes, this market will resolve to the lowest range bracket.

market.question: Will Benjamin Netanyahu be the next Prime Minister of Israel?
market.rules:
Legislative elections are schedule to be held in Israel on October 27, 2026. 

This market will resolve to the next individual who is officially appointed and sworn in as Prime Minister of Israel following the 2026 parliamentary election. If an election is called early, this market will immediately resolve to the individual who is officially appointed and sworn in after that election.

To count for resolution, the individual must be formally sworn in. Any interim or caretaker Prime Minister will not count toward the resolution of this market.

If no such Prime Minister is sworn in by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the Government of Israel; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

recent_facts.fact: A Channel 13 poll (1,103 respondents, margin of error 2.5%) gave Netanyahu's bloc 54 seats, the Jewish opposition bloc 52 and the Arab parties 14. Party seats: Yashar (Eisenkot) 21, Likud 19, Together (Bennett) 11, Democrats (Golan) 11.
Opposition bloc leaders have said they will not form a coalition that includes Arab parties. That leaves the 14 Arab-party seats in the Channel 13 poll outside either bloc's coalition math.

A Kan 11 poll (552 respondents, margin of error 4.2%) had the Eisenkot-led bloc and Netanyahu's bloc tied at 52 seats each, with the Arab parties at 12 and the Hendel–Zelekha party at 4. Yashar had 23 seats, Likud 21 and Together 11.
Across five recent polls, Yashar averaged 23.6 seats and Likud 21.8. Yashar led in four of the five; an i24NEWS poll had Likud first with 27 seats to Yashar's 22.

As of 2026-09-15, the 15-day polling average had Likud and Yashar tied at 23.2 seats each. The parties in Netanyahu's current coalition together averaged 54.9 seats, short of the 61 needed for a majority.
Polls taken after the list-submission deadline left both blocs short of 61. One Channel 12 poll had the change bloc at 54, the current coalition at 50, the Arab parties at 12 and Hendel–Zelekha at 4.

The 26th Knesset election is set for 2026-10-27. All 120 seats are filled by proportional representation with a 3.25% threshold, and 61 seats are needed for a majority. The question closes 2026-10-28, the day after the vote.
On October 2, the Supreme Court overturned disqualifications of Ra'am, the Joint List and candidate Ofer Cassif, so these Arab lists can run.

The question resolves only to a PM formally sworn in after the 2026 election; interim or caretaker PMs do not count. Netanyahu stays caretaker PM until a new government is sworn in, and if none is sworn in by 2027-12-31 the market resolves 'Other'.

Unverified, from memory: of the five Knesset elections from April 2019 to November 2022, two (April and September 2019) produced no government and led to new elections. Netanyahu was sworn in after March 2020 (May 2020) and November 2022 (Dec 29, 2022). After March 2021, Bennett was sworn in (June 2021).
Unverified, from memory: the time from election to swearing-in has ranged from about 8 weeks (2022) to about 12 weeks (2021). No government has been sworn in within a day of the vote.

market.question: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after the October 2026 meeting?
market.rules:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's October 2026 meeting.

The next FOMC meeting is October 27-28, 2026, and the statement comes out on October 28. If the upper bound of the range is raised from 4.00% to 4.25%, that counts as a 25 bp increase.

NY Fed President John Williams said there is 'no need for urgency' on changing policy. He suggested 'one further upward adjustment' may be appropriate late this year rather than in October.

Vice Chair Philip Jefferson said future adjustments should come from 'carefully examining trends in the data' and that coming to a judgment 'may take more time.' Minneapolis Fed President Kashkari said he had no strong view on an October hike and projected one more hike this year. Dallas Fed President Logan called the September hike a 'first step.'
Reporting said top Fed policymakers do not expect to deliver back-to-back hikes at the October meeting. Global brokerages now largely expect the next hike in December rather than October.
The August PCE price index rose 3.4% year over year. That is far above the Fed's 2% goal but no worse than July's reading.

At his roughly 30-minute September 16 press conference, Chair Warsh said 'inflation is too high and has been for too long' and promised a 'timelier return' to 2%. He declined to commit to further hikes and kept forward guidance limited.
CNN described the September hike as Warsh defying President Trump, who wants lower rates. The hike was driven by inflation tied to rising oil prices and Middle East tensions.
The September 2026 CPI report is scheduled for October 14, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. ET, two weeks before the October 28 FOMC decision.

recent_facts.fact: Cleveland is the AL's No. 2 seed. As a division champion it got a bye past the Wild Card round and is still alive. It plays the No. 6 seed White Sox in the best-of-five ALDS.
Cleveland finished the regular season 85-77, the 10th-best record of the 12 playoff teams. The White Sox won 84 games.

Wild Card results: the White Sox swept the Astros 2-0 and the Yankees swept the Red Sox 2-0 in the AL. In the NL, the Braves beat the Phillies 2-1 and the Padres swept the Cubs 2-0. The other teams with byes are the Rays (AL No. 1), Dodgers and Brewers.
Chicago won the regular-season series against Cleveland 7-6. These two teams have never met in the postseason before.

ALDS schedule: Game 1 is in Cleveland on Oct 3 at 1 p.m. ET and Game 2 is in Cleveland on Oct 5. Game 3 is in Chicago on Oct 7, and Game 4 (if needed) is in Chicago on Oct 8. Game 5 (if needed) is back in Cleveland on Oct 10.

Rookie left-hander Parker Messick starts Game 1 for Cleveland and Gavin Williams starts Game 2. Chicago starts rookie left-hander Hagen Smith in Game 1. No Game 1 result was available when this was researched.

To win the title, Cleveland would have to win three more rounds: the best-of-five ALDS, the best-of-seven ALCS against the Rays or the Yankees, and the best-of-seven World Series. All of these are due to finish before the question closes on Oct 31.
Under the 12-team format from 2022 to 2024, 6 of the 12 teams with byes lost in the Division Series and 3 lost in the LCS. One lost the World Series and 2 won it (2022 Astros, 2024 Dodgers).

In 2025, 3 of the 4 teams with byes won their Division Series (Brewers, Mariners, Blue Jays). That makes roughly 9 of 16 bye teams winning the DS since 2022. The 2025 champion Dodgers did not have a bye, so 2 of 16 bye teams went on to win the World Series. The 2025 part of this count and the 2025 champion come from memory and are unverified.

This market will resolve according to the company which owns the model which has the highest arena rank based on the arena.ai Text Arena (Overall) when the table under the "Leaderboard" tab is checked on October 31, 2026, 12:00 PM ET.

Results from the "Rank" column under the "Text Arena | Overall" Leaderboard tab at https://arena.ai/leaderboard/text/overall-no-style-control with style control off (Adjustments: None) and filtered for "Models" will be used to resolve this market.

Note: Models marked “AutoEval” at the applicable check time will not be considered, regardless of whether they display a rank or score.

Models will be ordered primarily by their leaderboard rank at the market’s check time. If two or more models are tied on rank, they will be ordered by their Arena score, including any underlying, unrounded, granular values reflected in the data below the leaderboard. If a tie still remains, alphabetical order of company names as listed in this market group will be used as a final tiebreaker (e.g., if the two models are tied by exact arena score, “Google” would be ranked ahead of “SpaceXAI”). This market will resolve based on the company that occupies first place under this ranking.

The resolution source for this market is the arena.ai Text Arena (Overall). If this resolution source is unavailable at check time, this market will remain open until the leaderboard comes back online and will resolve based on the first check after it becomes available. If it becomes permanently unavailable, this market will resolve to "Other".

market.question: Will the upper bound of the federal funds rate be above 4.00% following the Fed's Oct 28, 2026 meeting? (Above 4.00%)
market.rules:
If the upper bound of the target federal funds rate published on the Federal Reserve's official website is greater than 4.00% following the Federal Reserve's Oct 28, 2026 meeting, then the market resolves to Yes.
This market will expire the first 2:05 PM ET following the release of a Federal Reserve statement for their Oct 28, 2026 meeting or one week following the last day of that meeting.

recent_facts.fact: The FOMC told the Desk to keep the federal funds rate in a target range of 3-3/4 to 4 percent, effective September 17, 2026. The current upper bound is therefore exactly 4.00%, so a Yes needs a hike at the October 27–28 meeting. Interest on reserve balances was raised to 3.90% and the primary credit rate to 4.0%.

The FOMC voted unanimously to raise the target range by 25 bp to 3.75%–4.00%, its first rate increase since 2023. The statement said economic activity is expanding at a solid pace and inflation remains elevated.

The September dot plot's median for end-2026 is 4.1%, up from 3.8% in June, which implies one more 25 bp hike in 2026. 16 of 18 participants signaled at least one more hike this year. The 2027 median is also 4.1%.
Chair Kevin Warsh said 'inflation is too high, and has been for too long.' August CPI rose 0.4% month on month and 3.4% year on year, and crude oil was above $100/bbl amid Iran-related tensions.

September nonfarm payrolls rose 29,000, against a Dow Jones consensus of 84,000, and unemployment rose to 4.2% (consensus 4.1%). August was revised down to +133,000 and July to −10,000, a combined downward revision of 60,000.
Fed Vice Chair Philip Jefferson and New York Fed President John Williams both stressed patience. They said they would rather see more data before taking further action.
The August PCE report, released September 30, came in cooler than expected: core PCE was 3.0% year on year, against a consensus of 3.3%.
Warsh has said he will avoid giving investors clear signals about where rates are headed, which means less forward guidance before meetings.
The September 2026 CPI report is scheduled for Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET, before the October 27–28 FOMC meeting.
Warsh is scheduled for a moderated conversation at the IMF fall meetings in Bangkok on October 16 (11:30 pm ET on October 15). The FOMC decision is due October 28, 2026.

The Fed publishes the target range in its FOMC statement and implementation note. With the upper bound now at 4.00%, holding steady or cutting resolves No, and only an increase (to 4.25% or higher) resolves Yes.

market.question: Will Francis James Allison Oyague win the next Lima mayoral elections?
market.rules:
The 2026 Lima, Peru mayoral election is currently scheduled to be held on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who becomes the next Mayor of Lima as a result of this election.

Temporary, interim, or placeholder mayors appointed before the election will not be considered.

If the result of this election isn't known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting; however, if there is any ambiguity in the results, this market will resolve according to official information from the Peruvian government, including the National Jury of Elections (Jurado Nacional de Elecciones, JNE, https://jne.gob.pe) and the National Office of Electoral Processes (Oficina Nacional de Procesos Electorales, ONPE, https://www.onpe.gob.pe/).

recent_facts.fact: CIT's late poll had López Aliaga 33.4%, Bruce 12.0% and Allison 11.8%. In an earlier CIT poll (June 14–16) that left López Aliaga out, Allison led with 15.8%.
The Lima mayoral race is decided in a single round with no runoff, so the candidate with the most votes wins. There are 26 candidates.

López Aliaga, who was Lima's mayor until 2025, is registered as first councillor (primer regidor) on Renovación Popular's list. The list's mayoral nominee resigned, which makes him first in line to become mayor. Critics call this a disguised re-election that gets around the constitutional ban on immediate re-election.
The JNE (National Jury of Elections) confirmed López Aliaga's candidacy and rejected an appeal to exclude him. It said no challenge had been filed within the three-day deadline.
Days before the vote, the JNE had still not said whether it would give López Aliaga the mayor's credential if his list wins. APRA candidate Mónica Yaya asked Congress to call the JNE in to clarify.
Carlos Bruce took his complaint about a possible disguised re-election of López Aliaga to the OAS (Organization of American States).

Allison has been mayor of Magdalena del Mar for several terms over about 20 years and was briefly Housing Minister under Alan García. He was once arrested in the US for carrying more than $50,000 in cash and pleaded guilty to smuggling and perjury charges.
Allison said that if elected he would audit López Aliaga's administration, saying there were 'very clear signs of corruption'.
Campaigning closed on Oct 2. The municipal election is on Sunday, October 4, 2026, and ONPE (the national elections office) will publish the official count afterwards.

In 2018, Jorge Muñoz polled only 3.5% in Datum's final poll 11 days before the vote, yet went from fifth to first in the last week and won about 32% to Urresti's 21%. Reggiardo, who had led the polls, finished third with about 10%. (A single example; how often late reversals happen in Lima is unverified.)

market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $105 in October?
market.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, at any point after market creation and during a trading session of October 2026, any Pyth 1-minute candle for the Active Month of ICE Futures Europe WTI Crude Futures (denoted by Pyth as "CLL") has a final "High" or "Low" price equal to or beyond (above for ↑ High Prices, below for ↓ Low Prices) the listed price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Prices will be used exactly as published by Pyth, without rounding.

Only prices achieved during an applicable trading session of the specified timeframe's business days will be considered (See: "Trading Hours" at https://www.ice.com/products/213/WTI-Crude-Futures). The trading session for a given business day typically begins at 8:00 PM ET on the prior calendar date, except for the session dated Monday, which begins at 6:00 PM ET on the preceding Sunday, and where modified by holiday or other special hours (See: https://www.ice.com/holiday-hours).

The Active Month is the nearest listed contract, except during that contract's final three trading sessions. At the open of the third-to-last trading session, the next listed contract becomes the Active Month.

Each contract's last trading day will be determined by ICE Futures Europe per the WTI Crude Futures contract specification (generally the 4th US business day prior to the 25th calendar day of the month preceding the contract month, or five US business days prior if the 25th calendar day is not a US business day). The last trading day for each contract is posted at https://www.ice.com/products/213/WTI-Crude-Futures/expiry.

For example, if the last trading session for the nearest listed contract is the session for Monday the 20th, the next listed contract would become the Active Month at the start of the trading session for Thursday the 16th (8:00 PM ET on Wednesday), assuming a standard trading calendar.

If the relevant Pyth data is unavailable due to a system outage, data failure, or other disruption that prevents verification of the required 1-minute candle data, the official daily high/low price published for the Active Month WTI Crude Oil Futures contract by ICE Futures Europe may be used to determine whether the listed price was reached during the applicable trading session (See: https://www.ice.com/report/10 with "T-West Texas Intermediate Light Sweet Crude Future" selected).

In the event of a contract specification change, feed change, or similar structural modification affecting the underlying market during the listed time frame, this market will resolve based on adjusted prices as displayed on Pyth.

If the Active Month contract does not trade at all during the listed time frame, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market is Pyth — specifically, the ICE Futures Europe WTI Crude Futures Active Month "High" and "Low" prices available at https://app.pyth.com/explore?search=CLL, with the chart settings configured for 1-minute candles. Historical 1-minute candles may be accessed by appending a Unix timestamp (seconds) to the Pyth chart URL using the "t=" parameter.

recent_facts.fact: Front-month WTI settled at $91.11 on Oct 2, 2026, with an intraday range of $88.06–$93.51. On Oct 1 it closed at $92.87, range $88.79–$93.68. This is NYMEX CL data, not the Pyth/ICE 'CLL' feed named in the rules, but the two normally track each other closely.

recent_facts.fact: The curve is in backwardation: November 2026 WTI (CLX26) was quoted at $92.87 and December 2026 (CLZ26) at $90.84, so December was about $2 below November.

The November 2026 WTI contract (CLX26) expires Oct 20, 2026. Under the market's rule, the next contract becomes the Active Month at the open of the third-to-last session. Assuming ICE expiry matches NYMEX (I could not open the ICE expiry page), the roll to December, currently about $2 lower, would come at the Oct 16 session (opening 8 PM ET Oct 15).

Under US pressure, the G7 agreed on Oct 2 to release 100 million barrels of diesel, gasoline and crude from emergency reserves over four months. On the news, WTI fell $1.76 to settle at $91.11 and European gasoil futures dropped more than 4%.

On Oct 2 WTI touched a one-month low of $88.06. Gulf oil exports have recovered to near pre-conflict levels but remain unstable, and the US is reportedly sending a third aircraft carrier strike group to the Middle East. WTI was down 0.21% over the month and up about 50% year on year.
A CNBC headline on Oct 2 said oil was lower on the G7 diesel stock release and that the Saudis reportedly plan an attack on the Houthis. The article itself could not be accessed.

War broke out between the US/Israel and Iran on Feb 28, 2026, and supply through the Strait of Hormuz was choked. The WTI curve has been in steep backwardation since then, even after the temporary ceasefire of Apr 7.

About 21 US business-day trading sessions remain in October, Oct 5 through Oct 30. A one-minute Pyth CLL candle with a high of $95.00 or more in any of them resolves Yes. From the Oct 2 settlement of $91.11, that requires a rise of about 4.3%, before any contract-roll effect.
